en.s: The Battle of Avarayr (Armenian: Ավարայրի ճակատամարտ Avarayri čakatamart) was fought on 26 May 451 AD on the Avarayr Plain in Vaspurakan, between the Armenian Army under Vardan Mamikonian and Sassanid Persia. It was one of the first battles in defence of the Christian faith in history. Although the Persians were victorious on the battlefield itself, the battle proved to be a major strategic victory for Armenians, as Avarayr paved the way to the Nvarsak Treaty (484 AD), which affirmed Armenia's right to practice Christianity freely. The battle is widely seen as one of the most significant events in Armenian history.

zh.s: 阿瓦赖尔战役于公元451年5月26日在瓦斯普拉坎的阿瓦赖尔平原爆发，交战双方是瓦尔丹·马米科尼扬率领的亚美尼亚军队和萨珊波斯。它是历史上最早为捍卫基督教信仰而进行的战役之一。尽管波斯军队在战场上获胜，但这场战役在战略上对亚美尼亚人意义重大，为484年《努瓦尔萨克条约》的签订铺平了道路；条约确认亚美尼亚人有权自由信奉基督教。阿瓦赖尔战役被广泛视为亚美尼亚史上最重要的事件之一。

en.t: Basil I is crowned as co-emperor of the Byzantine Empire by Michael III
en.s: Basil I, nicknamed "the Macedonian" (Greek: Βασίλειος ὁ Μακεδών, romanized: Basíleios ō Makedṓn; 811 – 29 August 886), was Byzantine emperor from 867 to 886. Born to a peasant family in the theme of Macedonia, he rose to prominence in the imperial court after gaining the favour of Emperor Michael III, whose mistress he married on his emperor's orders. In 866, Michael proclaimed him co-emperor.

zh.t: 巴西尔一世由米海尔三世加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝
zh.s: 巴西尔一世绰号“马其顿人”（希腊语：Βασίλειος ὁ Μακεδών，转写：Basíleios ō Makedṓn；811年—886年8月29日），于867年至886年担任拜占庭皇帝。他出身马其顿军区的农民家庭，因获得米海尔三世皇帝的宠信而在宫廷崭露头角，并奉皇帝之命娶了皇帝的情妇。866年，米海尔宣布他为共治皇帝。

en.t: King Otto I elects his six-year-old son Otto II as heir apparent and co-ruler of the East Frankish Kingdom. He is crowned at Aachen, and placed under the tutelage of his grandmother Matilda
en.s: Otto II (955 – 7 December 983), called the Red (German: der Rote), was Holy Roman Emperor from 973 until his death in 983. A member of the Ottonian dynasty, he was the youngest and sole surviving son of Otto the Great and Adelaide of Italy. Otto II was made joint-ruler of Germany in 961, at an early age, and his father named him co-Emperor in 967 to secure his succession to the throne.

zh.t: 奥托一世册立6岁的儿子奥托二世为东法兰克王国储君和共治国王
zh.s: 奥托二世（955年—983年12月7日），绰号“红发者”（德语：der Rote），于973年至983年去世期间担任神圣罗马皇帝。他是奥托王朝成员，也是奥托大帝与意大利的阿德莱德唯一存活的幼子。奥托二世早年于961年被立为德国共治国王；967年，父亲又册立他为共治皇帝，以确保其继承皇位。

en.s: The Battle of the Stuhna River (sometimes written as Stugna River; on 26 May 1093) was fought between the princes of Kievan Rus', Sviatopolk II of Kiev, Vladimir II Monomakh of Chernigov, and Rostislav Vsevolodovich of Pereyaslavl against the nomadic Cumans. The Kievan forces were defeated.

zh.s: 斯图赫纳河战役（有时也写作斯图格纳河战役）于1093年5月26日爆发。交战双方是基辅罗斯诸公爵：基辅的斯维亚托波尔克二世、切尔尼戈夫的弗拉基米尔二世·莫诺马赫，以及佩列亚斯拉夫尔的罗斯季斯拉夫·弗谢沃洛多维奇；他们与游牧民族库曼人交战。基辅罗斯军队战败。

en.s: In 1111, the Almoravids launched a campaign into the County of Portugal, capturing Santarém and expanding their control over western Iberia. The campaign was led by Syr ibn Abi Bakr, the Almoravid governor of Al-Andalus, who advanced into Portuguese territory and captured Santarém on 25 or 26 May 1111. The conquest forced Henry, Count of Portugal, to retreat and strengthened Almoravid control over the western territories of the Iberian Peninsula.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1111年，阿尔摩拉维德王朝发起远征，攻入葡萄牙伯国并占领桑塔伦，扩大了其对伊比利亚半岛西部的控制。远征由阿尔摩拉维德王朝安达卢斯总督西尔·伊本·阿比·巴克尔率领，他进入葡萄牙领土并于1111年5月25日或26日攻占桑塔伦。此次征服迫使葡萄牙伯爵恩里克撤退，并巩固了阿尔摩拉维德王朝对伊比利亚半岛西部的控制。

en.t: Alfonso VII of León and Castile is crowned in León Cathedral as Imperator totius Hispaniae (Emperor of all of Spain)
en.s: Alfonso VII (1 March 1105 – 21 August 1157), called the Emperor (el Emperador), became the King of Galicia in 1111 and King of León and Castile in 1126. Alfonso, born Alfonso Raimúndez, first used the title Emperor of All Spain, alongside his mother Urraca, once she vested him with the direct rule of Toledo in 1116.

zh.t: 莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世在莱昂大教堂加冕，称“全西班牙皇帝”
zh.s: 阿方索七世（1105年3月1日—1157年8月21日），称“皇帝”（西班牙语：el Emperador），1111年成为加利西亚国王，1126年成为莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚国王。他出生时名为阿方索·雷蒙德斯，1116年母亲乌拉卡授予他托莱多的直接统治权后，他首次与母亲并用“全西班牙皇帝”头衔。

en.s: The Battle of Fossalta was fought on 26 May 1249 between the forces of Bologna and its allies and an imperial army commanded by Enzo of Sardinia, son of Emperor Emperor Frederick II. It formed part of the prolonged struggle between the Guelphs and Ghibellines in northern and central Italy and occurred near Fossalta, between Modena and Bologna, during a major Bolognese offensive against the imperial cities of Modena and Reggio Emilia.

zh.s: 福萨尔塔战役于1249年5月26日爆发，交战双方是博洛尼亚及其盟友的军队，以及由撒丁岛的恩佐（皇帝腓特烈二世之子）指挥的帝国军队。这场战役是意大利北部和中部归尔甫派与吉伯林派长期斗争的一部分，发生在福萨尔塔附近，位于摩德纳和博洛尼亚之间；当时博洛尼亚正大举进攻帝国控制的摩德纳与雷焦艾米利亚。

en.t: An earthquake strikes Kamakura, Kanagawa, Japan, killing about 23,000
en.s: The 1293 Kamakura earthquake in Japan occurred at about 06:00 local time on 27 May 1293. It had an estimated magnitude of 7.1–7.5 and triggered a tsunami. The estimated death toll was 23,024. It occurred during the Kamakura period, and the city of Kamakura was seriously damaged. In the confusion following the quake, Hōjō Sadatoki, the Shikken of the Kamakura shogunate, carried out a purge against his subordinate Taira no Yoritsuna.

zh.t: 日本神奈川县镰仓发生地震，约23,000人遇难
zh.s: 1293年镰仓地震于当地时间1293年5月27日约06:00发生，估计震级为7.1至7.5级，并引发海啸。估计死亡人数为23,024人。地震发生在镰仓时代，镰仓市遭受严重破坏。地震后局势混乱，镰仓幕府执权北条贞时清洗其部属平赖纲。

en.s: The Bruce campaign was a three-year military campaign in Ireland by Edward Bruce, brother of the Scottish king Robert the Bruce. It lasted from his landing at Larne in 1315 to his defeat and death in 1318 at the Battle of Faughart in County Louth. It was part of the First War of Scottish Independence against England, and the conflict between the Irish and Anglo-Normans.

zh.t: 布鲁斯在爱尔兰的军事行动
zh.s: 苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯的弟弟爱德华·布鲁斯在爱尔兰开展了为期三年的军事行动。行动于1315年在拉恩登陆时开始，1318年在劳斯郡的福奥哈特战役中以失败和爱德华阵亡告终。这场行动既是第一次苏格兰独立战争的一部分，也涉及爱尔兰人与盎格鲁-诺曼人的冲突。

en.s: Samogitian uprisings refer to two uprisings by the Samogitians against the Teutonic Knights in 1401–1404 and 1409. Samogitia was granted to the Teutonic Knights by Vytautas the Great, Grand Duke of Lithuania, several times in order to enlist Knights' support for his other military affairs. The local population resisted Teutonic rule and asked Vytautas to protect them.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨莫吉希亚起义指1401—1404年和1409年萨莫吉希亚人反抗条顿骑士团的两次起义。立陶宛大公维陶塔斯大帝曾多次将萨莫吉希亚交给条顿骑士团，以换取骑士团支持他的其他军事行动。当地居民反抗条顿统治，并请求维陶塔斯保护。

en.s: The Battle of Haarlemmermeer was a naval engagement fought on 26 May 1573, during the early stages of the Dutch War of Independence. It was fought on the waters of the Haarlemmermeer – a large lake which at the time was a prominent feature of North Holland (it would be drained in the 19th century). A Spanish fleet and a fleet belonging to the city of Amsterdam (at the time still loyal to Spain), commanded by the Count of Bossu, fought a fleet of rebellious Dutch Geuzen, commanded by Marinus Brandt, who were trying to break the Siege of Haarlem.

zh.s: 哈勒默梅尔湖战役是1573年5月26日发生的一场海战，属于荷兰独立战争初期的战事。交战地点是哈勒默梅尔湖。当时这座大湖是北荷兰的重要地貌，19世纪后被排干。博苏伯爵指挥的西班牙舰队和阿姆斯特丹市舰队（当时仍效忠西班牙），与马里努斯·布兰特指挥的荷兰起义军“海上乞丐”舰队交战。后者试图打破哈勒姆围城。

en.s: The Battle of Sluis was a naval battle during the Eighty Years' War in which a Spanish squadron commanded by the Italian captain Federico Spinola tried to break through a blockade of Sluis by Dutch ships under the command of Joos de Moor. After about two hours of fighting the heavily damaged Spanish ships returned to Sluis. Federico Spinola was killed during the action.

zh.s: 斯吕斯战役是八十年战争期间的一场海战。费德里科·斯皮诺拉率领的西班牙舰队试图突破约斯·德·莫尔指挥的荷兰舰队对斯吕斯的封锁。交战约两小时后，受损严重的西班牙舰船退回斯吕斯。费德里科·斯皮诺拉在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Kashii (樫井の戦い) was the first battle of the Summer Campaign of the Siege of Osaka, fought in Japan in 1615, near the beginning of the Edo period. It took place on the 26th day of the 4th month of the Keichō era. As the Shōgun's Eastern Army prepared to renew the siege begun the previous winter, the Ōsaka garrison sallied and ambushed Tokugawa forces in a number of skirmishes and sieges.

zh.s: 樫井之战是大阪之战夏之阵的第一场战斗，1615年在日本江户时代初期打响。按庆长年号计，战斗发生在庆长十八年四月二十六日。将军的东军准备重新围攻大阪城时，大阪守军出城，在多次小规模交战和围攻中伏击德川军。

en.s: The Mystic massacre took place on May 26, 1637 during the Pequot War, when English settlers under Captain John Mason and Narragansett and Mohegan allies set fire to a fortified Pequot village near the Mystic River. They shot any people who tried to escape the wooden palisade fortress and killed the entire village in retaliation for previous Pequot attacks.

zh.s: 米斯蒂克大屠杀发生于1637年5月26日佩科特战争期间。约翰·梅森上尉率领的英国殖民者及纳拉甘西特和莫希干盟友，放火焚烧米斯蒂克河附近一座设防的佩科特村落，并向试图逃离木栅堡垒的人开枪。为报复佩科特人此前的袭击，他们杀害了村中所有人。

en.s: The Battle of Honnecourt was a battle of the Thirty Years' War fought on 26 May 1642. The Spanish, led by Francisco de Melo, were victorious over the French under Antoine III de Gramont, Comte de Guiche. In this battle the French Champagne army was all but annihilated. It lost three quarters of its men against a force double its size. 3200 men were killed and 3400 captured, including army commander Josias Rantzau, leaving Northern France wide open for the Spanish army. But the Spanish victory was not exploited because Francisco de Melo decided to be cautious.

zh.s: 奥讷库尔战役是三十年战争中的一场战役，于1642年5月26日爆发。弗朗西斯科·德·梅洛率领的西班牙军队击败了吉什伯爵安托万三世·德·格拉蒙率领的法国军队。法国香槟军几乎全军覆没；尽管兵力只有对方的一半，法军仍损失了四分之三的兵力，共有3,200人阵亡、3,400人被俘，包括军队指挥官约西亚斯·兰茨奥。这让西班牙军队得以长驱直入法国北部，但德·梅洛决定采取谨慎策略，没有乘胜推进。

en.s: The Battle of Montijo was fought on 26 May 1644, in Montijo, Spain, between Portuguese and Spanish forces. Although the battle ended with a Portuguese victory, the Spanish saw it as a strategic success as they claimed to have prevented Matias de Albuquerque from capturing Badajoz, despite Albuquerque having no intention of attacking the city.

zh.s: 蒙蒂霍战役于1644年5月26日在西班牙蒙蒂霍爆发，交战双方是葡萄牙和西班牙军队。战役以葡萄牙获胜告终，但西班牙方面认为这在战略上仍算成功，因为他们声称阻止了马蒂亚斯·德·阿尔布开克攻占巴达霍斯，尽管阿尔布开克本无意进攻该城。

en.s: Battle of Korsuń (Ukrainian: Корсунь, Polish: Korsuń), (May 26, 1648) was the second significant battle of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day city of Korsun-Shevchenkivskyi in central Ukraine, a numerically superior force of Cossacks and Crimean Tatars under the command of Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky and Tugay Bey attacked and defeated Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Hetmans Mikołaj Potocki and Marcin Kalinowski. As in the previous battle at Zhovti Vody, the outmanned Commonwealth forces took a defensive position, retreated, and were thoroughly routed by the opposing force.

zh.s: 科尔孙战役（乌克兰语：Корсунь；波兰语：Korsuń）于1648年5月26日爆发，是赫梅利尼茨基起义中的第二场重要战役。战场靠近今乌克兰中部的科尔孙-舍甫琴基夫斯基市。博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基盖特曼和图盖贝伊率领数量占优的哥萨克与克里米亚鞑靼联军，击败了尼古拉·波托茨基和马尔钦·卡利诺夫斯基两位盖特曼指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦军队。与此前的若夫季沃迪战役一样，兵力不足的联邦军采取防守、随后撤退，最终被对手彻底击溃。

en.s: The battle of Bornholm was a naval battle between a superior Swedish and a smaller Danish-Dutch fleet that was fought 25–26 May 1676 as a part of the Scanian War. The objective for both sides was naval supremacy in the southern Baltic Sea. The Swedish commander Lorentz Creutz sought to destroy the allied fleet and then land reinforcements in Swedish Pomerania to relieve the Swedish forces in northern Germany.

zh.s: 博恩霍尔姆海战是斯堪尼亚战争期间的一场海战，于1676年5月25日至26日爆发。交战双方是兵力占优的瑞典舰队和规模较小的丹麦—荷兰联军舰队。双方都希望取得波罗的海南部的制海权。瑞典指挥官洛伦茨·克鲁茨企图摧毁联军舰队，并随后在瑞典波美拉尼亚登陆增援部队，以解救驻扎在德国北部的瑞典军队。

en.s: The Battle of St. Louis, Spanish San Luis, also known as the Battle of Fort San Carlos, was an unsuccessful British-led attack on St. Louis (a French settlement in Spanish Louisiana, founded on the west bank of the Mississippi, after the Treaty of Paris (1763)) on May 26, 1780, during the Anglo-Spanish War. A force, composed primarily of Indians and led by a former British militia commander, attacked the settlement. The settlement's defenders, mostly local militia, under the command of Lieutenant Governor of Spanish Louisiana Fernando de Leyba, had fortified the town as best they could and successfully withstood the attack.

zh.s: 圣路易斯战役又称圣卡洛斯堡战役。1780年5月26日，英军主导的部队在盎格鲁-西班牙战争期间进攻圣路易斯，但未能得手。圣路易斯当时是西属路易斯安那的一处法国人聚居地，位于密西西比河西岸，1763年《巴黎条约》签订后建立。一支主要由原住民组成的部队在一名前英国民兵指挥官带领下发起进攻。西属路易斯安那副总督费尔南多·德莱瓦指挥当地民兵守城，并尽可能加固城镇防御，最终成功抵挡了进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Opsa took place on 26 May 1792, during the Polish-Russian War of 1792. The battle was fought near the tiny village of Opsa, near Brasław, Grand Duchy of Lithuania (present-day Belarus), between the Russian corps of Prince Yuri Dolgorukov and the Tatar regiment of the Grand Duchy, commanded by Michał Kirkor. The battle ended in a Russian victory, as the Lithuanians were forced to retreat and the Russians occupied Brasław.

zh.s: 奥普萨战役于1792年5月26日在1792年波俄战争期间爆发。战斗发生在立陶宛大公国布拉斯瓦夫附近的小村庄奥普萨一带（今属白俄罗斯）。交战双方是尤里·多尔戈鲁科夫亲王指挥的俄军和米哈乌·基尔科尔指挥的大公国鞑靼团。俄军获胜，立陶宛军队被迫撤退，俄军随后占领布拉斯瓦夫。

en.s: The Battle of Tara Hill was fought on the evening of 26 May 1798 between British forces and Irish rebels involved in the Irish Rebellion of 1798, resulting in a heavy defeat for the rebels and the end of the rebellion in County Meath.

zh.s: 塔拉山战役于1798年5月26日晚爆发，交战双方是英国军队和参加1798年爱尔兰起义的爱尔兰叛军。战役以叛军惨败告终，爱尔兰米斯郡的起义也随之结束。

en.s: The Battle of (the) Chiusella River or Battle of Romano (26 May 1800) saw the vanguard of a French Republican army led by First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte attack a Habsburg Austrian division led by Feldmarschall-Leutnant (FML) Karl Joseph Hadik von Futak. The action occurred in the Marengo campaign during the War of the Second Coalition. In May 1800, Bonaparte's Reserve Army crossed the Great St Bernard Pass into the Aosta Valley in northwestern Italy.

en.s: The Battle of Ostrołęka of 26 May 1831 was one of the largest engagements of Poland's November Uprising. Throughout the day, Polish forces under Jan Skrzynecki fought for the control over the town of Ostrołęka against the assaulting Russian forces of Hans Karl von Diebitsch. Although by the end of the day the town was still in Polish hands and the two sides suffered comparable losses, the battle is usually considered a Polish defeat because of the Russian army's almost unlimited strategic reinforcement capability. The Polish Army could not similarly replenish its casualties.

zh.s: 瓦雷泽战役于1859年5月26日在伦巴第的瓦雷泽爆发，是第二次意大利独立战争中的一场战斗。朱塞佩·加里波第率领的阿尔卑斯猎兵意大利志愿军与奥地利军队交战。奥军战败后，猎兵得以向科莫推进，奥军也被迫在战线北部留驻兵力。

Insurgent forces were commanded by Edmund Różycki, and the battle ended in Polish victory.

zh.s: 萨利哈战役是波兰一月起义期间波兰起义军与俄罗斯帝国军队之间的一场战斗，于1863年5月26日在萨利哈村附近爆发。该村当时位于俄罗斯帝国境内，如今属于乌克兰赫梅利尼茨基州。起义军由埃德蒙·鲁日茨基指挥，最终波兰军队获胜。

en.s: The Treaty of Gandamak (Dari: معاهده گندمک, Pashto: د گندمک تړون) officially ended the first phase of the Second Anglo-Afghan War. The Afghan emir Mohammad Yaqub Khan ceded various frontier areas as well as Afghanistan's control of its foreign affairs to the British Raj. en.s: The Battle of Tacna, also known as the Battle of Alliance Heights (Spanish: Batalla del Alto de la Alianza), effectively destroyed the Peru-Bolivian alliance against Chile, forged by a secret treaty signed in 1873. On May 26, 1880, the Chilean northern operations army led by General Manuel Baquedano González, conclusively defeated a Peru-Bolivian army commanded by Bolivian President, General Narciso Campero, after almost five hours of fierce combat. This battle took place at the Inti Urqu (Intiorko) hill plateau, a few miles north of the Peruvian city of Tacna. As a result, Bolivia was knocked out of the war, leaving Peru to fight the rest of the war alone.

zh.s: 塔克纳战役又称联盟高地战役（西班牙语：Batalla del Alto de la Alianza），最终摧毁了秘鲁和玻利维亚针对智利结成的联盟。该联盟源于1873年签订的一项秘密条约。1880年5月26日，曼努埃尔·巴克达诺·冈萨雷斯将军率领的智利北方作战军经过近五小时激战，彻底击败了由玻利维亚总统纳西索·坎佩罗将军指挥的秘鲁—玻利维亚联军。战斗发生在塔克纳城以北数英里的因蒂乌尔库（因蒂奥尔科）高原。玻利维亚因此退出战争，秘鲁只能独自继续作战。

en.s: Nicholas II (Nikolai Alexandrovich Romanov; 18 May [O.S. 6 May] 1868 – 17 July 1918) was Emperor of Russia from 1 November 1894 until his abdication in 1917. en.t: Românul de la Pind, the longest-running newspaper by and about Aromanians until World War II, is founded
en.s: Românul de la Pind ("The Romanian of the Pindus" in Romanian) was a Romanian weekly newspaper. It was founded on 26 May 1903 in Bucharest, Romania, by the Aromanian cultural activist Nicolae Constantin Batzaria, who was the director of the newspaper, in collaboration with several other Aromanian colleagues in the Ottoman Empire. Early issues of the newspaper carried the name Reforme ("Reforms" in Romanian), and were under the authorship of an anonymous committee.

en.s: The 1910 Copa del Rey final (FECF) was the 9th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey (although technically there was no final, with the tournament being played as a mini-group of three teams). It was one of two rival Cup competitions played in that year due to disagreements between the reigning champion of the tournament, Club Ciclista de San Sebastián, and some of the clubs invited. The final was played at Tiro del Pichón in Madrid on 26 May 1910.

en.t: The Democratic Republic of Georgia is established
en.s: The Democratic Republic of Georgia (DRG; Georgian: საქართველოს დემოკრატიული რესპუბლიკა, romanized: sakartvelos demok'rat'iuli resp'ublik'a) was the first modern establishment of a republic of Georgia, which existed from May 1918 to March 1921. Recognized by all major European powers of the time, DRG was created in the wake of the Russian Revolution of 1917, which led to the collapse of the Russian Empire and allowed territories formerly under Russia's rule to assert independence.

zh.t: 格鲁吉亚民主共和国成立
zh.s: 格鲁吉亚民主共和国（DRG；格鲁吉亚语：საქართველოს დემოკრატიული რესპუბლიკა，转写：sakartvelos demok'rat'iuli resp'ublik'a）是现代格鲁吉亚建立的首个共和国，存在于1918年5月至1921年3月。该国获得当时所有主要欧洲强国承认。它是在1917年俄国革命、俄罗斯帝国解体后成立的，使原属俄罗斯统治的地区得以宣布独立。

en.s: Mohammed ben Abdelkrim El Khattabi, better known as Abd el-Krim (12 January 1882 – 6 February 1963), was a Moroccan revolutionary, religious, political and military leader and the president of the Republic of the Rif. zh.s: 穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒克里姆·哈塔比，以阿卜杜勒-克里姆之名闻名（1882年1月12日—1963年2月6日），是摩洛哥革命家、宗教、政治和军事领袖，也是里夫共和国总统。他与兄弟穆罕默德领导里夫部落联盟大规模起义，反抗西班牙和法国对里夫及摩洛哥其他地区的保护国统治。

en.s: The Battle of Dunkirk (French: Bataille de Dunkerque) was fought around the French port of Dunkirk (Dunkerque) during the Second World War, between the Allies and Nazi Germany. As the Allies were losing the Battle of France on the Western Front, the Battle of Dunkirk was the defence and evacuation of British and other Allied forces to Britain from 26 May to 4 June 1940.
en.n: World War II: Operation Dynamo: In northern France, Allied forces begin a massive evacuation from Dunkirk, France. The Battle of Dunkirk begins simultaneously as Allied defenders fight to slow down the German offensive.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，敦刻尔克战役围绕法国敦刻尔克港展开，交战双方是盟军和纳粹德国。法国在西线战场节节败退，盟军于1940年5月26日至6月4日防守敦刻尔克，并从当地海滩和港口撤往英国。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战——“发电机行动”：盟军开始从法国北部敦刻尔克大规模撤离。盟军守军同时与德军交战，敦刻尔克战役由此开始。

en.s: The Serpa Pinto incident was a World War II maritime incident that occurred on 26 May 1944 in the Atlantic Ocean when the German submarine U-541 stopped and searched the Portuguese ocean liner Serpa Pinto. After detaining the ship's crew and passengers for around nine hours, the ship was allowed to continue its course. However, there were three deaths and the two Americans were captured and detained by the Germans.

zh.s: 1944年5月26日，第二次世界大战期间，德国U-541号潜艇在大西洋拦截并搜查葡萄牙远洋客轮“塞尔帕·平托”号。扣留船员和乘客约9小时后，潜艇允许客轮继续航行。此次事件造成3人死亡，德国人还俘虏并拘押了两名美国人。

en.s: The Battle of Changsha of 1944 (also known as the Battle of Hengyang or Campaign of Changsha-Hengyang; Chinese: 長衡會戰) was an invasion of the Chinese province of Hunan by Japanese troops near the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War. As such, it encompasses three separate conflicts: an invasion of the city of Changsha and two invasions of Hengyang.

zh.s: 1946年法国杯决赛于1946年5月26日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦奥林匹克体育场举行。里尔奥林匹克以4比2击败红星队，博莱克·滕波夫斯基、勒内·比埃尔和罗杰·范多伦（两球）为里尔进球。

en.s: The parliamentary election in South Africa on 26 May 1948 represented a turning point in the country's history. The United Party, which had led the government since its foundation in 1933, and its leader, incumbent Prime Minister Jan Smuts, were ousted by the Reunited National Party (Herenigde Nasionale Party in Afrikaans), led by Daniel Francois Malan, a Dutch Reformed cleric. During the election battle, both the UP and the NP formed coalitions with smaller parties. The UP was aligned with the left-leaning Labour Party, while the Afrikaner Party sought to advance Afrikaner rights by allying with the HNP.

zh.s: 南非于1948年5月26日举行议会选举，这次选举成为该国历史的转折点。自1933年执政至今的统一党及其领袖、时任总理扬·史沫资被赶下台。取而代之的是由荷兰归正会牧师丹尼尔·弗朗索瓦·马兰领导的联合国民党（南非语：Herenigde Nasionale Party）。竞选期间，统一党和国民党都与小党组成联盟：统一党与偏左的工党结盟，阿非利卡人党则通过与联合国民党结盟来推动南非白人权益。

en.s: The 1953 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 7, 1953, with a run-off election on May 26, 1953. Incumbent Fletcher Bowron was defeated by Norris Poulson, a U.S. Representative. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

en.s: The 1955 United Kingdom general election was held on 26 May 1955, four years after the previous general election. It resulted in a substantially increased majority of 60 for the Conservative government under new leader and prime minister Sir Anthony Eden against the Labour Party, then in their twentieth year of leadership by Clement Attlee. This general election has since been described by many as one of the "dullest" post war elections, because there was little change in the country, with Labour steadily losing ground owing to infighting between the left (Bevanites) and the right (Gaitskellites).

zh.s: 英国于1955年5月26日举行大选，距上一次大选四年。新任保守党领袖兼首相安东尼·艾登爵士领导的保守党政府扩大了多数席位，领先工党60席。此后，许多人将这次大选称为战后“最沉闷”的选举之一，因为英国局势变化不大；工党则因左派贝文派与右派盖茨克尔派内斗而逐渐失去支持。克莱门特·艾德礼当时已连续20年担任工党领袖。

en.t: 1955 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 26 May 1955, the 1955 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 630 members of the House of Commons, with 511 constituencies being in England. It was called immediately after Anthony Eden succeeded Sir Winston Churchill as prime minister in order to strengthen the position of the Conservative Party in the Commons where it enjoyed only a slender majority.

zh.t: 1955年英国大选英格兰地区结果
zh.s: 1955年5月26日（星期四），英国在英格兰举行大选，选出下议院全部630名议员，其中英格兰有511个选区。温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士卸任后，安东尼·艾登接任首相。为增强保守党在下议院的地位（当时该党只占微弱多数），他随即宣布提前举行大选。

en.t: 1955 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 26 May 1955, the 1955 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 630 members of the House of Commons, including the 12 Northern Ireland seats in single-seat constituencies using first-past-the-post. This was the first election to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom since the creation of Northern Ireland in 1921 where all constituencies in the region were contested The Ulster Unionists regained the seat which they had lost to Jack Beattie from the Irish Labour Party.

zh.t: 1955年英国大选北爱尔兰地区结果
zh.s: 1955年5月26日，英国在北爱尔兰举行大选，采用简单多数制，在单议席选区选举英国下议院的全部630名议员，其中包括北爱尔兰的12个席位。这是1921年北爱尔兰成立以来，英国下议院首次在该地区所有选区都有候选人参选的一次大选。阿尔斯特统一党重新赢回此前输给爱尔兰工党杰克·比蒂的席位。

en.t: 1955 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: On Thursday 26 May 1955, the 1955 United Kingdom general election was held in Scotland, to elect all 630 seats of the House of Commons, with 71 constituencies being in Scotland. The election was the first of 18 general elections held under the reign of Queen Elizabeth II, the fifth and the last election in which the Labour Party was led by Clement Attlee, and the first general election for which television coverage remains in existence.

zh.t: 1955年英国大选苏格兰地区结果
zh.s: 1955年5月26日（星期四），英国在苏格兰举行大选，选出下议院全部630个席位，其中苏格兰有71个选区。这是伊丽莎白二世在位期间举行的18次大选中的第一次，也是克莱门特·艾德礼领导工党的最后一次大选；此外，这也是首个留有电视转播录像的英国大选。

en.s: The 1957 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 26, 1957, that saw Toulouse claim their first Coupe de France title by defeating Angers 6–3 thanks to goals by René Dereuddre (2), Abdelhamid Bouchouk, Robert Bocchi, Eduardo Di Loreto and Said Brahimi. The match referee was Englishman Jack Clough; this is the only Coupe de France final officiated by a non-French referee to date.

zh.s: 1957年法国杯决赛于1957年5月26日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦奥林匹克体育场举行。图卢兹以6比3击败昂热，首次夺得法国杯冠军。勒内·德吕德尔梅开二度，阿卜杜勒哈米德·布舒克、罗贝尔·博基、爱德华多·迪洛雷托和赛义德·布拉希米各进一球。主裁判是英格兰人杰克·克拉夫。这是迄今唯一一场由非法国裁判执法的法国杯决赛。

en.s: The 1964 Orlando mayoral election was on May 26, 1964, following a primary election on May 5, 1964, to elect the mayor of Orlando, Florida. Incumbent Mayor Bob Carr ran for re-election to a third term. Carr was challenged for re-election by City Commissioner Wally Sanderlin, contractor Carl T. Langford, and businessman Ed Wilson.

zh.s: 奥兰多于1964年5月26日举行市长选举。此前，该市于5月5日举行初选。寻求第三个任期的现任市长鲍勃·卡尔，面对市委员沃利·桑德林、承包商卡尔·T·兰福德和商人埃德·威尔逊的挑战。

en.t: British Guiana gains independence, becoming Guyana
en.s: British Guiana was a British colony located on the northern coast of South America. Since 1966 it has been known as the independent nation of Guyana. The first known Europeans to encounter Guiana were Sir Walter Raleigh, an English explorer, and his crew. Raleigh published a book entitled The Discovery of Guiana, but this mainly relates to the Guayana region of Venezuela.

zh.t: 英属圭亚那独立，成立圭亚那
zh.s: 英属圭亚那曾是南美洲北岸的一块英国殖民地。该地于1966年独立，成立圭亚那。最早到达圭亚那的欧洲人是英国探险家沃尔特·罗利爵士及其船员。罗利出版过《圭亚那发现记》，但书中主要讲的是委内瑞拉的圭亚那地区。

en.t: Guyana: Independence from the United Kingdom as Guyana
en.s: Guyana, officially the Republic of Guyana, is a country in South America. It is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the north, Suriname to the east, Brazil to the south and southwest, and Venezuela to the west. It is part of the Guianas. The capital and largest city is Georgetown.

zh.t: 圭亚那脱离英国独立，成立圭亚那国

en.s: The Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty, also known as the ABM Treaty or ABMT, was a 1972 arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union on the limitation of the anti-ballistic missile (ABM) systems used in defending areas against strategic ballistic missiles, which are used to deliver nuclear weapons It was intended to reduce pressures to build more nuclear weapons to maintain deterrence.

zh.s: 叙利亚于1973年5月25日至26日举行议会选举。阿拉伯社会主义复兴党赢得186个席位中的122席，取得胜利。这也是由叙利亚领导的复兴党首次参加议会选举；原阿拉伯社会主义复兴党已于1966年解散。

en.t: Italian Prime Minister Arnaldo Forlani and his coalition cabinet resign following a scandal over membership of the pseudo-masonic lodge P2 (Propaganda Due)
en.s: Arnaldo Forlani (Italian: [arˈnaldo forˈlaːni] ; 8 December 1925 – 6 July 2023) was an Italian politician who served as Prime Minister of Italy from 1980 to 1981. He also held the office of Deputy Prime Minister of Italy, Minister of Foreign Affairs, and Minister of Defence. In 1981, together with Bettino Craxi and Giulio Andreotti, Forlani promoted the Pentapartito, the political coalition between the five major Italian parties that ruled Italy between 1981 and 1991.

zh.s: 阿纳尔多·福尔拉尼（意大利语发音：[arˈnaldo forˈlaːni]；1925年12月8日—2023年7月6日）是意大利政治家，1980年至1981年担任意大利总理。他还担任过副总理、外交部长和国防部长。1981年，他与贝蒂诺·克拉克西和朱利奥·安德烈奥蒂共同推动五党联盟；该联盟由五个主要政党组成，1981年至1991年执政。

en.s: The 1982 European Cup final was played on 26 May 1982 at the end of the 1981–82 European Cup season. Football League First Division winners Aston Villa defeated Bundesliga winners Bayern Munich 1–0 at De Kuip in Rotterdam, Netherlands, to win their first European Cup; this continued the streak of English teams winning the competition in six straight seasons.

zh.s: 1982年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1981—82赛季结束时举行。英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛冠军阿斯顿维拉于1982年5月26日在荷兰鹿特丹的费耶诺德球场，以1比0击败德甲冠军拜仁慕尼黑，首次夺得欧洲冠军杯。这延续了英格兰球队连续六个赛季赢得该项赛事冠军的纪录。

en.s: Lee Shih-ke (Chinese: 李師科; March 5, 1927 – May 26, 1982) was a Chinese-born murderer and armed robber who perpetrated Taiwan's first gunpoint bank heist. An army veteran and taxi driver, he murdered a police officer in January 1980 with the intention of using the officer's gun to rob a bank. He carried out the robbery on April 14, 1982, and was captured and executed within six weeks.

zh.s: 李师科（中文：李師科；1927年3月5日—1982年5月26日）是出生于中国的杀人犯和持枪抢劫犯，曾实施台湾首次持枪银行抢劫案。他当过军人和出租车司机。1980年1月，他杀害了一名警察，打算拿走警枪后抢劫银行。1982年4月14日，他实施抢劫，并在六周内被捕及处决。

en.s: The 1983 Sea of Japan earthquake (Japanese: 日本海中部地震) occurred on May 26, 1983, at 11:59:57 local time (02:59:57 UTC). It had a magnitude of 7.8 on the moment magnitude scale. It occurred in the Sea of Japan, about 100 km west of the coast of Noshiro in Akita Prefecture, Japan.

en.s: The 1985 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1984–85 DFB-Pokal, the 42nd season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 26 May 1985 at the Olympiastadion in West Berlin. Bayer Uerdingen won the match 2–1 against Bayern Munich to claim their first cup title. This was Bayern's first cup final loss in what was their eighth final.

zh.s: 1985年德国杯决赛决出了1984—85赛季德国杯冠军，是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第42个赛季决赛。比赛于1985年5月26日在西柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。乌丁根巴耶尔以2比1击败拜仁慕尼黑，首次夺得德国杯。拜仁队史此前七次打进决赛，这是他们首次在德国杯决赛中失利。

en.s: The 1987 Jacksonville mayoral election took place on May 26, 1987. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Jake Godbold was term-limited and could not run for a third consecutive term. Former State Representative Tommy Hazouri won the Democratic primary against former State Representative John Lewis, and faced City Council President Henry Cook, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Hazouri defeated Cook in a landslide, winning 75 percent of the vote to Cook's 25 percent.

zh.s: 杰克逊维尔于1987年5月26日举行市长选举。时任民主党市长杰克·戈德博尔因任期限制，不能连续第三次参选。前州众议员汤米·哈祖里在民主党初选中击败前州众议员约翰·刘易斯，随后在大选中对阵共和党提名人、市议会主席亨利·库克。哈祖里以75%的得票率大胜，库克获得25%。

en.s: The final match of the 1988–89 Football League season was contested at Anfield between Liverpool and Arsenal, respectively the first and second-placed teams in the First Division, on 26 May 1989. The clubs were close enough on points for the match to act as a decider for the championship. However, Arsenal had to win by at least two goals to overtake Liverpool in the table; anything else would result in Liverpool becoming champions.

zh.s: 1988—89赛季英格兰足球联赛最后一场比赛于1989年5月26日在安菲尔德球场举行，参赛双方是当时排名第一和第二的利物浦与阿森纳。这场比赛直接关系到联赛冠军归属。阿森纳必须至少净胜两球才能反超利物浦登顶；否则利物浦将夺冠。

en.s: The 1991 Spanish local elections were held on Sunday, 26 May 1991, throughout all 8,082 Spain municipalities, simultaneously with regional elections in 13 of the 17 autonomous communities—all except for Andalusia, the Basque Country, Catalonia, and Galicia. en.s: The 1991 Associate Members' Cup Final, known as the Leyland DAF Cup for sponsorship reasons, was the 8th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from the Third Division and Fourth Division. The final was played at Wembley Stadium, London on 26 May 1991, and was contested by Birmingham City and Tranmere Rovers. Birmingham won the match 3–2, with Simon Sturridge and John Gayle scoring the goals for the winning team.

zh.s: 1991年英格兰联赛杯决赛因赞助冠名而称为莱兰DAF杯决赛，是英格兰足球第三级和第四级球队参加的国内杯赛第八届决赛。比赛于1991年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由伯明翰城对阵特兰米尔流浪者。伯明翰以3比2获胜，西蒙·斯特里奇和约翰·盖尔为球队进球。

en.s: Lauda Air Flight 004 was a regularly scheduled international passenger flight from Hong Kong, via Bangkok, Thailand, to Vienna, Austria. On 26 May 1991, the Boeing 767 operating the route crashed following an uncommanded deployment of the thrust reverser on the No. 1 engine during the climb phase, causing the aircraft to enter an aerodynamic stall, uncontrolled dive, and in-flight breakup, killing all 213 passengers and ten crew members on board.

zh.s: 劳达航空004号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，从香港经泰国曼谷飞往奥地利维也纳。1991年5月26日，执飞该航线的波音767客机在爬升阶段，1号发动机的反推装置意外启动，导致飞机失速、失控俯冲，随后在空中解体。机上213名乘客和10名机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: In Your House 8: Beware of Dog
en.s: In Your House 8: Beware of Dog was the eighth In Your House professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), that originally took place on May 26, 1996, from the Florence Civic Center in Florence, South Carolina. Due to a severe thunderstorm, the power went out during the event, resulting in only two matches being shown on pay-per-view and a series of, literal, dark matches. The televised event was rescheduled as "Beware of Dog 2" and took place on May 28, 1996, at the North Charleston Coliseum in North Charleston, South Carolina.

zh.s: 《家门之内8：当心恶犬》是世界摔角联合会（WWF）制作的第八场“家门之内”系列按次付费赛事，原定于1996年5月26日在南卡罗来纳州佛罗伦萨市政中心举行。当天遭遇强雷暴并停电，按次付费直播只播出了两场比赛，此外还临时举行了几场没有电视转播的比赛。电视转播活动随后改名为《当心恶犬2》，并于5月28日在北查尔斯顿市的北查尔斯顿体育馆举行。

en.t: 1996 Football League Second Division play-off final
en.s: The 1996 Football League Second Division play-off final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium on 26 May 1996, at the end of the 1995–96 English league season to determine the final promoted club from the Second Division. Bradford City beat Notts County 2–0 to join Swindon Town and Oxford United in winning promotion to the First Division.

zh.t: 1996年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1996年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于1995—96赛季结束时举行，比赛于1996年5月26日在温布利球场进行，决定最后一支从乙级联赛升级的球队。布拉德福德城以2比0击败诺茨郡，和斯温顿镇、牛津联一同升入甲级联赛。

en.s: The 1996 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the NSC Olimpiyskiy on 26 May 1996. The match was the 5th Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by FC Dynamo Kyiv and FC Nyva Vinnytsia. The 1996 Ukrainian Cup Final was the fifth to be held in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Dynamo won with goals from Serhii Rebrov and Yuri Maxymov.

zh.s: 1996年乌克兰杯决赛于1996年5月26日在基辅的奥林匹克国家综合体育场举行，是第5届乌克兰杯决赛。参赛双方是基辅迪纳摩和文尼察尼瓦。该届是第五次在乌克兰首都基辅举行的杯赛决赛。谢尔希·雷布罗夫和尤里·马克西莫夫进球，帮助基辅迪纳摩获胜。

en.s: The 1996 Belgian Cup final, took place on 26 May 1996 and was a Bruges derby between Club Brugge and Cercle Brugge. It was the 41st Belgian Cup final. Cercle Brugge took the lead through an early goal by Gábor Torma, but two goals by Mario Stanić still in the first half tilted the tie in favour of Club Brugge.

zh.s: 1996年比利时杯决赛于1996年5月26日举行，是布鲁日俱乐部和色格拉布鲁日之间的一场布鲁日德比，也是第41届比利时杯决赛。加博尔·托尔马开场不久就为色格拉布鲁日破门，但马里奥·斯塔尼奇在上半场梅开二度，帮助布鲁日俱乐部反超并占据优势。

en.s: The 1996 National Soccer League Grand Final was the first grand final to be held under the A-League name after the short-lived rebranding of the National Soccer League (NSL) began before the 1995–96 season. Melbourne Knights defeated Marconi-Fairfield 2–1 to win their second consecutive grand final.

zh.t: 1996年澳大利亚国家足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 1996年澳大利亚国家足球联赛总决赛是该联赛在1995—96赛季短暂更名为“A-League”后，首次以该名称举行的总决赛。墨尔本骑士以2比1击败马可尼-费尔菲尔德，连续第二年夺得总决赛冠军。

en.t: 1997 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 1997 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match played between Crystal Palace and Sheffield United on 26 May 1997 at Wembley Stadium, London, England. The game was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the second tier Football League First Division to the Premier League, the highest tier of English league football.

zh.t: 1997年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 1997年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于1997年5月26日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是水晶宫和谢菲尔德联。这场比赛决定谁将成为第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰第二级联赛甲级联赛升入顶级英超的球队。

en.s: The 1998 MIAT Mongolian Airlines crash was a domestic flight operated by MIAT Mongolian Airlines that crashed on 26 May 1998, killing all on board. The flight departed Erdenet Airport at approximately 09:17 on a flight to Mörön, with 26 passengers and 2 crew. Approximately 13 minutes after departure, while the plane was climbing to cruising altitude, it struck the top of a 6,500 ft mountain, killing all passengers and crew.

zh.t: 1998年蒙古MIAT航空哈尔滨Y-12坠机事故
zh.s: 1998年5月26日，蒙古MIAT航空一架执行国内航班的飞机失事，机上人员全部遇难。航班于约9时17分从额尔登特机场起飞，飞往木伦，机上有26名乘客和2名机组人员。起飞约13分钟后，飞机爬升至巡航高度途中撞上了一座海拔6,500英尺的山顶，机上所有乘客和机组人员遇难。

en.s: The 1998 Gali clashes took place in the Gali district of Abkhazia, after ethnic Georgians launched an insurgency against the Abkhazian separatist government. The conflict is sometimes referred to as the Six-Day War of Abkhazia; however, this name only takes into account the Abkhazian offensive that lasted from 20 to 26 May 1998, while hostilities and insurgent attacks had already occurred before that date.

en.s: New Jersey v. New York, 523 U.S. 767 (1998), was a U.S. Supreme Court case that determined that roughly 83% of Ellis Island was part of New Jersey, rather than New York State. Because the New Jersey original 1664 land grant was unclear, the states of New Jersey and New York disputed ownership and jurisdiction over the Hudson River and its islands.
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 新泽西州诉纽约州案（523 U.S. 767，1998年）是美国最高法院审理的一起案件。法院裁定，埃利斯岛约83%的土地属于新泽西州，而非纽约州。由于新泽西州最初于1664年获得的土地授予界线不明确，新泽西州和纽约州对哈德逊河及其岛屿的所有权和管辖权存在争议。

en.s: The 1999 UEFA Champions League final was an association football match between Manchester United of England and Bayern Munich of Germany, played at Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain, on 26 May 1999, to determine the winner of the 1998–99 UEFA Champions League. Injury time goals from Manchester United's Teddy Sheringham and Ole Gunnar Solskjær cancelled out Mario Basler's early goal for Bayern to give Manchester United a 2–1 win and their first European Cup title since 1968, their second overall.

zh.s: 1999年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于1999年5月26日在西班牙巴塞罗那的诺坎普球场举行，参赛双方是英格兰的曼彻斯特联和德国的拜仁慕尼黑，决出1998—99赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军。比赛早段，拜仁的马里奥·巴斯勒率先破门；伤停补时阶段，曼联的泰迪·谢林汉姆和奥莱·居纳尔·索尔斯克亚连进两球，以2比1逆转获胜。这是曼联自1968年以来首次、也是队史第二次夺得欧洲冠军杯。

en.s: The 1999 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Bulgarian Army Stadium in Sofia on 26 May 1999, and was contested between the sides of Litex Lovech and CSKA Sofia. The match was won by CSKA Sofia, Valentin Stanchev scored the winning goal.

zh.s: 1999年保加利亚杯决赛于1999年5月26日在索非亚保加利亚军队体育场举行，参赛双方是洛维奇利特克斯和索非亚中央陆军。中央陆军获胜，瓦伦丁·斯坦切夫攻入制胜球。

en.t: 2000 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 2000 Football League Third Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2000 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Peterborough United and Darlington. It was to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Third Division to the Second Division.

zh.t: 2000年英格兰足球联赛第三级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2000年英格兰足球联赛第三级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2000年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是彼得伯勒联和达灵顿。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第四支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入第二级的球队。

en.s: Triplemanía IX was the ninth Triplemanía professional wrestling show promoted by AAA. The show took place on May 26, 2001 in Mexico City, Mexico. The Main event featured a Dog collar match Lucha de Apuestas match where the last man remaining in the match would have his hair shaved off. The participants were Pirata Morgan, El Cobarde and Sangre Chicana.

zh.s: Triplemanía IX是墨西哥摔角推广机构AAA举办的第九场Triplemanía职业摔角赛事。赛事于2001年5月26日在墨西哥城举行。主赛是一场狗项圈赛形式的“赌注赛”，最后留在场上的选手将被剃光头发。参赛者是海盗摩根、懦夫和奇卡诺血。

en.s: The 2001 Scottish Cup Final was played on 26 May 2001 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 116th Scottish Cup competition. Celtic and Hibernian contested the match, which Celtic won 3–0, completing the third domestic treble in the club's history. Jackie McNamara opened the scoring in the first half running onto a through ball to angle the ball past Hibernian goalkeeper Nick Colgan.

zh.s: 2001年苏格兰杯决赛于2001年5月26日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第116届苏格兰杯赛事的决赛。凯尔特人和希伯尼安争夺冠军，凯尔特人以3比0获胜，完成队史第三次国内三冠王。上半场，杰基·麦克纳马拉接到一记直塞球后斜射破门，为凯尔特人首开纪录。

en.t: 2001 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 2001 Football League Third Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2001 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, between Blackpool and Leyton Orient. It was to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Third Division to the Second Division.

zh.t: 2001年英格兰足球联赛第三级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2001年英格兰足球联赛第三级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2001年5月26日在加的夫千禧球场举行，参赛双方是布莱克浦和莱顿东方。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第四支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛第三级升入第二级的球队。

en.s: The 2001 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2000–01 DFB-Pokal, the 58th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 26 May 2001 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Schalke 04 won the match 2–0 against Union Berlin to claim their 3rd cup title.

zh.s: 2001年德国杯决赛决出了2000—01赛季德国杯冠军，是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第58个赛季决赛。比赛于2001年5月26日在西柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。沙尔克04以2比0击败柏林联合，第三次夺得德国杯冠军。

en.s: The 2001 El Paso mayoral election was held on May 26, 2001, to elect the mayor of El Paso, Texas. It saw the election of Raymond Caballero. Caballero defeated former mayor Larry Francis.

zh.s: 埃尔帕索于2001年5月26日举行市长选举，选举雷蒙德·卡瓦列罗为市长。卡瓦列罗击败了前市长拉里·弗朗西斯。

en.s: The 2001 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 26 May 2001, that saw RC Strasbourg defeat Amiens SC in a penalty shoot-out. After 120 minutes of play could not separate the two sides, the match went to penalties. Jean-Paul Abalo missed for Amiens, while José Luis Chilavert secured the victory for the Alsatian side.

zh.s: 2001年法国杯决赛于2001年5月26日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。斯特拉斯堡竞技在点球大战中击败亚眠。双方在120分钟内战平，比赛因此进入点球大战。亚眠球员让-保罗·阿巴洛射失点球，何塞·路易斯·奇拉维特帮助阿尔萨斯球队锁定胜局。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 26 May 2002. Álvaro Uribe, the candidate of the recently-created Colombia First movement, was elected, receiving 54% of the vote by the first round. Uribe took office on 7 August.

zh.s: 哥伦比亚于2002年5月26日举行总统选举。新成立的“哥伦比亚第一”运动候选人阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦在首轮投票中获得54%的选票，当选总统。他于8月7日就职。

en.s: A bridge collapse occurred southeast of Webbers Falls, Oklahoma, United States, at 7:45 a.m. on May 26, 2002. Freight barges being transported on the Arkansas River collided with a pier supporting the Interstate 40 road bridge crossing the river. The resulting failure of the supports caused a section of the bridge to collapse, killing 14 people and injuring another 11.

zh.s: 2002年5月26日上午7时45分，美国俄克拉何马州韦伯斯瀑布东南方向的一座大桥发生坍塌。当时，阿肯色河上运输的货船驳船撞上了支撑州际公路40号公路桥的桥墩。桥梁支撑结构因此失效，部分桥体坍塌，造成14人死亡、另有11人受伤。

en.s: The 2002 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the NSC Olimpiyskiy on May 26, 2002. The match was the 11th Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by Shakhtar Donetsk and Dynamo Kyiv. The 2002 Ukrainian Cup Final was the eleventh to be held in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Shakhtar won by three goals to two.

zh.s: 2002年乌克兰杯决赛于2002年5月26日在基辅的奥林匹克国家综合体育场举行，是第11届乌克兰杯决赛。参赛双方是顿涅茨克矿工和基辅迪纳摩。该届是第11次在乌克兰首都基辅举行的杯赛决赛。顿涅茨克矿工以3比2获胜。

en.t: 2003 Football League First Division play-off final
en.s: The 2003 Football League First Division play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2003 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, between Sheffield United and Wolverhampton Wanderers. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the Football League First Division, the second tier of English football, to the FA Premier League.

zh.t: 2003年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2003年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2003年5月26日在加的夫千禧球场举行，参赛双方是谢菲尔德联和伍尔弗汉普顿流浪者。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛甲级（英格兰第二级联赛）升入英超的球队。

en.s: Ukrainian-Mediterranean Airlines Flight 4230 was a chartered international passenger flight, a Yakovlev Yak-42D operated by Ukrainian UM Airlines, which crashed in 2003. Flying from Manas International Airport, Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan to Zaragoza Airport, Spain, the Yak-42D tried to land at Trabzon Airport in Turkey to refuel on May 26, 2003, but, because of dense fog, it slammed into a mountain near Maçka, Trabzon.

zh.t: 乌克兰-地中海航空4230号班机空难
zh.s: 乌克兰-地中海航空4230号班机是一趟包机国际客运航班，由乌克兰UM航空运营，机型为雅克-42D，于2003年失事。飞机从吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克的玛纳斯国际机场飞往西班牙萨拉戈萨机场。2003年5月26日，飞机尝试在土耳其特拉布宗机场降落加油，但由于浓雾，撞上特拉布宗省马奇卡附近的一座山。

en.s: The 2004 UEFA Champions League final was an association football match played on 26 May 2004 to decide the winner of the 2003–04 UEFA Champions League. AS Monaco, a Monaco-based club representing the French Football Federation, faced Portuguese side Porto at the Arena AufSchalke in Gelsenkirchen, Germany. Porto won the match 3–0, with Carlos Alberto, Deco and Dmitri Alenichev scoring the goals in a dominant game from Jose Mourinho's Porto.

zh.s: 2004年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2004年5月26日举行，决出2003—04赛季赛事冠军。总部位于摩纳哥、代表法国足协参赛的摩纳哥队对阵葡萄牙球队波尔图，比赛在德国盖尔森基兴的傲赴沙尔克球场举行。波尔图以3比0获胜，卡洛斯·阿尔贝托、德科和德米特里·阿连尼切夫进球。若泽·穆里尼奥麾下的波尔图全场占据优势。

en.s: A leadership election was held by the People's Justice Party (PKR) on 26 May 2007. It was won by incumbent President of PKR, Wan Azizah Wan Ismail.

zh.s: 人民公正党（PKR）于2007年5月26日举行党魁选举。时任党主席旺阿兹莎·旺依斯迈胜出。

en.s: UFC 71: Liddell vs. Jackson was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship. The event took place on Saturday, May 26, 2007 at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada.

zh.s: UFC 71：利德尔对阵杰克逊是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，于2007年5月26日（星期六）在内华达州拉斯维加斯的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2007 Scottish Cup Final was played on 26 May 2007 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 121st Scottish Cup. The final was contested by Celtic, who beat St Johnstone 2–1 in the semi-final, and Dunfermline Athletic, who beat Hibernian 1–0 in a replay, after the first match had ended 0–0.

zh.s: 2007年苏格兰杯决赛于2007年5月26日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第121届苏格兰杯决赛。参赛双方是凯尔特人和邓弗姆林竞技。凯尔特人在半决赛中以2比1击败圣约翰斯通；邓弗姆林则在首场半决赛0比0战平希伯尼安后，通过重赛晋级。

en.s: The 2007 Football League Two play-off final was an association football match which was on 26 May 2007 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Bristol Rovers and Shrewsbury Town to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from Football League Two to Football League One.

zh.t: 2007年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2007年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2007年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是布里斯托尔流浪者和什鲁斯伯里镇。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第四支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛乙级升入甲级的球队。

en.s: The 2007 Cupa României final was the 69th final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Stadionul Dan Păltinişanu in Timișoara on 26 May 2007 and was contested between Liga I sides FCU Politehnica Timișoara and Rapid București. The cup was won by Rapid after goals from Buga and Zicu with the latter winning the Man Of The Match Award.

zh.s: 2007年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最重要的杯赛第69届决赛。比赛于2007年5月26日在蒂米什瓦拉的丹·帕尔蒂尼沙努球场举行，参赛双方是罗甲球队蒂米什瓦拉FCU波利泰尼卡和布加勒斯特快速。快速队凭借布加和齐库的进球夺冠，齐库还获得全场最佳球员奖。

en.s: The 2007 Belgian Cup final, took place on 26 May 2007 between Club Brugge and Standard Liège. It was the 52nd Belgian Cup final and was won by Club Brugge due to a goal by Manasseh Ishiaku.

zh.s: 2007年比利时杯决赛于2007年5月26日举行，参赛双方是布鲁日俱乐部和标准列日。这是第52届比利时杯决赛，马纳塞·伊希阿库攻入一球，帮助布鲁日俱乐部获胜。

en.s: Operation Kamin ("Ambush" in Persian) was an offensive launched by Taliban insurgents in May 2007 which aimed to kill American-backed government forces and foreign troops in Kandahar.

zh.s: 卡明行动（Kamin在波斯语中意为“伏击”）是塔利班武装人员于2007年5月发起的一次攻势，目标是杀死由美国支持的政府军和外国部队。

en.s: The 2007 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2006–07 DFB-Pokal, the 64th running of Germany's premier football cup competition. In the final, 1. FC Nürnberg defeated VfB Stuttgart 3–2 after extra time, thereby claiming their fourth title and denying Bundesliga champions Stuttgart a double. A 109th-minute strike from Danish midfielder Jan Kristiansen won the game for Nürnberg.

zh.s: 2007年德国杯决赛决出了2006—07赛季德国杯冠军，是德国顶级足球杯赛的第64届赛事决赛。比赛进入加时赛后，纽伦堡以3比2击败斯图加特，第四次夺冠，也让德甲冠军斯图加特无缘双冠王。丹麦中场扬·克里斯蒂安森在第109分钟攻入制胜球。

en.s: The 2008 Football League Two play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2008 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Stockport County and Rochdale to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from Football League Two to the Football League One.

zh.t: 2008年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2008年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2008年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是斯托克波特郡和罗奇代尔。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛乙级升入甲级的球队。

en.s: Dream.9: Feather Weight Grand Prix 2009 Second Round was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Fighting and Entertainment Group's mixed martial arts promotion Dream on May 26, 2009. It featured the second round of the promotion's featherweight (63 kilograms (139 lb)) grand prix and saw the return of Norifumi Yamamoto, who was given a first round bye, as well as a middleweight title fight between Ronaldo Souza and Jason Miller.

zh.s: DREAM.9：2009年羽量级大奖赛第二轮是综合格斗赛事，由格斗与娱乐集团旗下的DREAM于2009年5月26日举办。赛事包括羽量级（63公斤／139磅）大奖赛第二轮，阔别赛场的山本德郁也回归；他在首轮轮空。此外还有一场由罗纳尔多·索萨对阵杰森·米勒的中量级冠军赛。

en.s: The 2009 Bulgarian Cup final was the 69th final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final was played at the Georgi Asparuhov Stadium in Sofia on 26 May 2009, and marked the first time that the final has been staged at this stadium. The match was contested by Litex Lovech, who beat Minyor Pernik 1–0 in their semi-final, and Pirin Blagoevgrad who beat Levski Sofia 1–0.

zh.s: 2009年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事的第69届决赛，于2009年5月26日在索非亚格奥尔基·阿斯帕鲁霍夫体育场举行。这是决赛首次在该体育场举办。参赛双方是洛维奇利特克斯和布拉戈耶夫格勒皮林。利特克斯在半决赛中以1比0击败佩尔尼克矿工；皮林则以1比0击败索非亚列夫斯基。

en.s: The 2010 Cupa României final was the 72nd final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Emil Alexandrescu stadium in Iaşi between the Cup's holder, CFR Cluj and FC Vaslui. The trophy was won for the third year in a row by CFR Cluj after penalty kicks.

zh.s: 2010年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该项罗马尼亚顶级杯赛的第72届决赛。比赛在雅西的埃米尔·亚历山德雷斯库体育场举行，参赛双方是卫冕冠军克卢日和瓦斯卢伊。克卢日通过点球大战获胜，连续第三年夺冠。

en.s: The Magyar Kupa final was the final match of the 2009–10 Magyar Kupa, played between Debrecen and Zalaegerszeg.

zh.s: 2009—10赛季匈牙利杯决赛由德布勒森和佐洛埃格塞格交锋。

en.s: The 2011 UEFA Women's Champions League Final was the final of the second season of the UEFA Women's Champions League and was held at Fulham's Craven Cottage in London, England, on 26 May 2011. For the second year in a row, Lyon met Turbine Potsdam in the final. Unlike last year, Lyon came up with the victory as they defeated Potsdam 2–0 after goals from Wendie Renard and Lara Dickenmann.

zh.s: 2011年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是该赛事第二个赛季的决赛，于2011年5月26日在英格兰伦敦的富勒姆克雷文别墅球场举行。连续第二年，里昂在决赛中对阵波茨坦涡轮队。这一次里昂以2比0获胜，温迪·勒纳尔和拉拉·迪肯曼各进一球。

en.s: The 2011 Fuzhou bombings (simplified Chinese: 抚州市连环爆炸案; traditional Chinese: 撫州市連環爆炸案; pinyin: Fǔzhōu shì liánhuán bàozhà àn) were three separate, synchronized explosions at government buildings in Fuzhou, Jiangxi, China on the morning of 26 May 2011. At least three people died, and at least seven were injured. The perpetrator, 52-year-old Qian Mingqi, was among those killed in the blasts, leading China's state-run news agencies to label it a suicide bombing.

zh.s: 2011年5月26日上午，中国江西省抚州市的政府大楼发生三起分别引爆、但时间同步的爆炸。至少3人死亡、至少7人受伤。52岁的钱明奇是爆炸案实施者，也在爆炸中身亡；中国官方媒体因此将此事件称为自杀式爆炸袭击。

en.s: A by-election for the Hougang Single Member Constituency in Singapore was held on 26 May 2012 because of the expulsion of Yaw Shin Leong from the Workers' Party of Singapore on 15 February 2012, which he decided not to appeal. On 22 February 2012, the Speaker Michael Palmer declared the seat vacant, effective from the date of expulsion, as required by the Constitution of the Republic of Singapore. This was the 16th by-election since the first election, and the first by-election after over 19 years. This was the first by-election in Singapore since the new millennium and the 21st Century.

zh.s: 新加坡后港单选区于2012年5月26日举行补选。工人党于2月15日开除饶欣龙党籍，他决定不提出上诉，因此触发了此次补选。根据新加坡共和国宪法，议长迈克尔·帕默于2月22日宣布该议席自开除党籍之日起出缺。这是新加坡举行的第16次补选，也是相隔19年多以来的首次；同时也是新千年和21世纪以来的新加坡首次补选。

en.s: UFC 146: dos Santos vs. Mir was a mixed martial arts (MMA) pay-per-view event (PPV) promoted by the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) on May 26, 2012 at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada. The main card featured five MMA bouts which were shown on PPV, as well as seven preliminary bouts which were shown on FX, and Facebook.

zh.s: UFC 146：多斯桑托斯对阵米尔是由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗付费直播赛事，于2012年5月26日在内华达州拉斯维加斯的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。主赛包括5场通过付费直播播出的综合格斗比赛，另有7场预赛通过FX电视网和Facebook播出。

en.s: The 2012 Football League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2012 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Huddersfield Town and Sheffield United to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from Football League One to the Football League Championship.

zh.t: 2012年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2012年英格兰足球联赛甲级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2012年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是哈德斯菲尔德镇和谢菲尔德联。这场比赛决定谁将成为第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛甲级升入英冠的球队。

en.s: The 2012 FA Women's Cup final was the 42nd final of the FA Women's Cup. 276 clubs competed for the years trophy. The winners did not qualify for the UEFA Women's Champions League. Birmingham City, beat Chelsea 3–2 in a penalty shoot-out after a 2–2 draw in the final at Ashton Gate. The match was televised live by Sky Sports 2.

zh.s: 2012年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该项赛事的第42届决赛。当年共有276家俱乐部参赛，冠军没有获得欧洲女子冠军联赛参赛资格。伯明翰城与切尔西在阿什顿门球场的决赛中战成2比2，伯明翰最终通过点球大战以3比2获胜。比赛由天空体育2台现场直播。

en.s: The year 2012 was the first year in the history of Glory, an international kickboxing event. 2012 starts with Glory 1: Stockholm, and ends with Dream 18 & Glory 4: Tokyo. The events were broadcast through television agreements with regional channels around the world.

zh.s: 2012年是国际踢拳赛事Glory历史上的第一年。赛事从“Glory 1：斯德哥尔摩”开幕，以“Dream 18”和“Glory 4：东京”收官。各场赛事通过与世界各地地区频道签订的电视协议播出。

en.s: The 2013 Scottish Cup final was the 128th final of the Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match took place at Hampden Park on 26 May 2013 and was contested by Hibernian and Celtic. It was the first time the two clubs had played each other in the Scottish Cup since the 2001 final, which Celtic won 3–0, but Hibs' second consecutive final following their heavy defeat against Hearts the previous year.

zh.s: 2013年苏格兰杯决赛是该赛事的第128届决赛，也是苏格兰最重要的足球淘汰赛决赛。比赛于2013年5月26日在汉普顿公园球场举行，由希伯尼安对阵凯尔特人。两队自2001年决赛（凯尔特人以3比0获胜）后，首次在苏格兰杯中交锋。希伯尼安则连续第二年打进决赛；上一年他们惨败给哈茨。

en.s: The 2013 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 2012–13 Taça de Portugal, the 73rd season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 26 May 2013 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed Benfica and Vitória de Guimarães.

zh.s: 2013年葡萄牙杯决赛是2012—13赛季该项赛事的最后一场比赛，也是葡萄牙足球协会主办的葡萄牙顶级足球杯赛第73个赛季的决赛。比赛于2013年5月26日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，参赛双方是本菲卡和吉马良斯胜利。

en.s: The 2013 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2012–13 Coppa Italia, the top cup competition in Italian football. The match was played at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome between Lazio and Roma on Sunday, 26 May 2013 at 18:00 CET. Lazio had played 7 Coppa Italia finals and Roma 16, but the two sides had never met each other in the final prior to this match.

zh.s: 2013年意大利杯决赛是2012—13赛季意大利足球顶级杯赛的最后一场比赛，于2013年5月26日（星期日）欧洲中部时间18时在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，参赛双方是拉齐奥和罗马。拉齐奥此前7次打进意大利杯决赛，罗马则打进过16次，但这是两队首次在决赛中相遇。

en.s: The 2013 Svenska Cupen final was played on 26 May 2013. The match was played at the national stadium Friends Arena in Solna which was completed in November 2012 and hosted the final for the first time. The final made its return to Solna for the first time since 2009 and it was also the first time since 2006 that the final was played at a neutral venue.

zh.s: 2013年瑞典杯决赛于2013年5月26日举行，比赛在索尔纳的国家体育场友谊竞技场进行。球场于2012年11月竣工，这是该场馆首次承办决赛。自2009年以来，决赛首次回到索尔纳举行；自2006年以来，决赛也首次在中立场地进行。

en.s: The 2013 FA Women's Cup final was the 43rd final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 20th to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal Ladies and Bristol Academy on 26 May 2013 at Keepmoat Stadium in Doncaster. Holders Arsenal made its 12th final win.

zh.s: 2013年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该赛事的第43届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队参加的顶级杯赛决赛。英格兰足球总会直接负责举办的决赛中，这是第20届。比赛于2013年5月26日在唐卡斯特基普莫特体育场举行，参赛双方是阿森纳女足和布里斯托尔学院队。卫冕冠军阿森纳第12次夺冠。

en.s: The 2013 Central Java gubernatorial election was held on 26 May 2013 to elect both the governor and vice governor of Central Java. The incumbent, Bibit Waluyo, ran for re-election as a member of the Democratic Party, despite being first elected as a member of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P) in 2008.

zh.s: 中爪哇省于2013年5月26日举行选举，选出省长和副省长。时任省长比比特·瓦尤洛以民主党党员身份寻求连任；他在2008年首次当选时是印度尼西亚斗争民主党（PDI-P）成员。

en.s: The 2014 Football League Two play-off final was an association football match played on 26 May 2014 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Burton Albion and Fleetwood Town. The match determined the fourth and final team to gain promotion from Football League Two, English football's fourth tier, to Football League One.

zh.t: 2014年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2014年英格兰足球联赛乙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2014年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是伯顿阿尔比恩和弗利特伍德镇。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第四支、也是最后一支从英格兰足球联赛乙级（英格兰第四级联赛）升入甲级的球队。

en.s: The elections of the Dutch Senate were held on 26 May 2015. The elected senators were sworn in on 9 June 2015.

zh.s: 荷兰于2015年5月26日举行参议院选举。当选参议员于6月9日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2015 Malaysia FA Cup final was a football match which was played on 26 May 2015, to determine the champion of the 2015 Malaysia FA Cup. The final was played between Kelantan FA and Felda LionsXII. LionsXII won 3–1 to win their first Malaysia FA Cup title.

zh.s: 2015年马来西亚足总杯决赛于2015年5月26日举行，决出当年马来西亚足总杯冠军。参赛双方是吉兰丹足协队和Felda LionsXII。LionsXII以3比1获胜，首次夺得马来西亚足总杯。

en.s: The Palmyra offensive of May 2015 was a military operation launched during the Syrian Civil War by the Islamic State (IS) on May 13–26, 2015, in an attempt to capture the government-held Tadmur District of the Homs Governorate, including the administrative centre of Tadmur, known in English as Palmyra. The ruins and ancient monuments of Palmyra, which lie on the south-western fringe of the modern city, have been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1980.

zh.s: 2015年5月13日至26日，伊斯兰国（IS）在叙利亚内战期间发动巴尔米拉攻势，试图夺取政府控制的霍姆斯省塔德穆尔区，包括该区行政中心塔德穆尔（英文名为巴尔米拉）。巴尔米拉古城遗址和古迹位于现代城市西南边缘，自1980年以来被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

en.s: The 2016 UEFA Women's Champions League Final was the final match of the 2015–16 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 15th season of Europe's premier women's club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the seventh season since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup to the UEFA Women's Champions League. It was played at the Mapei Stadium – Città del Tricolore stadium in Reggio Emilia, Italy, on 26 May 2016, between German team Wolfsburg and French team Lyon.

zh.s: 2016年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2015—16赛季欧洲女子冠军联赛的最后一场比赛，也是该项欧洲顶级女子俱乐部足球赛事的第15个赛季决赛。该赛事由欧足联组织；自欧洲女子联盟杯更名为欧洲女子冠军联赛以来，这是第七届赛事。比赛于2016年5月26日在意大利雷焦艾米利亚的马佩体育场—三色城球场举行，参赛双方是德国球队沃尔夫斯堡和法国球队里昂。

en.s: The 2018 EFL Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2018 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Aston Villa and Fulham. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League.

zh.s: 2018年英冠升级附加赛决赛于2018年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是阿斯顿维拉和富勒姆。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第三支、也是最后一支从英冠（英格兰第二级联赛）升入英超的球队。

en.s: The Talataye attack occurred on May 26, 2018, during the Mali War. Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (IS-GS) fighters attacked a festival in Talataye, Mali, killing several civilians and Movement for the Salvation of Azawad (MSA) fighters.

zh.s: 2018年5月26日，马里战争期间，大撒哈拉伊斯兰国（IS-GS）武装人员袭击了马里塔拉塔耶的一场节庆活动，造成数名平民和阿扎瓦德解放运动（MSA）武装人员死亡。

en.s: Municipal elections took place in Iceland on 26 May 2018. 55 of the 72 municipal councils in the country were elected using open list PR. The rural municipality Tjörneshreppur did not hold an election as only one list was presented, whose candidates were thereby automatically elected. No list was presented in 16 municipalities.

zh.s: 冰岛于2018年5月26日举行市政选举，全国72个市镇议会中有55个举行选举，采用开放名单比例代表制。农村市镇蒂约尔内斯赫雷普尔只有一份候选名单，因此候选人自动当选，未举行投票。另有16个市镇没有候选名单。

en.s: The 2018 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2017–18 UEFA Champions League, the 63rd season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 26th season since it was renamed from the European Cup to the UEFA Champions League. It was played at the NSC Olimpiyskiy in Kyiv, Ukraine on 26 May 2018, between Spanish side and defending champions Real Madrid, who had won the competition in each of the previous two seasons, and English side Liverpool, making their eighth final appearance and first since 2007.

zh.s: 2018年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2017—18赛季赛事的决赛，也是欧足联组织的欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第63个赛季的决赛。该赛事从欧洲冠军杯更名为欧洲冠军联赛后，这是第26届。比赛于2018年5月26日在乌克兰基辅的奥林匹克国家综合体育场举行，参赛双方是西班牙卫冕冠军皇家马德里和英格兰利物浦。皇马此前已连续两个赛季夺冠；利物浦第八次打进决赛，也是自2007年以来首次。

en.s: The 2018 Pro14 Grand Final was the final match of the 2017–18 Pro14 season. The 2017–18 season is the fourth with Guinness as the title sponsor, the ninth with a Grand Final and the first season with 14 teams, following the admission of two South African teams. The final was played at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin and saw Leinster defeat the Scarlets 40–32.

zh.s: 2018年Pro14联赛总决赛是2017—18赛季该联赛的最后一场比赛。该赛季是吉尼斯冠名赞助的第四个赛季，是设立总决赛后的第九个赛季，也是南非两支球队加入后联赛首次扩军至14队。决赛在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，伦斯特以40比32击败猩红队。

en.s: A by-election for the Zlín Senate seat in the Czech Republic was held on 18 and 19 May 2018 as a result of František Čuba's resignation. The second round was heldr 25 and 26 May 2018. Michaela Blahová and Tomáš Goláň advanced to second round. The election was surprisingly won by Tomáš Goláň. Voter turnout was very low.

zh.s: 捷克兹林参议院选区于2018年5月18日至19日举行补选，起因是弗朗季舍克·丘巴辞职。第二轮投票于5月25日至26日举行，米哈埃拉·布拉霍娃和托马什·戈拉尼晋级。最终戈拉尼意外获胜，投票率很低。

en.s: The 2019 Piedmontese regional election took place on 26 May 2019, the same day as the 2019 European Parliament election in Italy. The election was for all 50 members of the Regional Council of Piedmont, as well as for the president of Piedmont, who is also a member of the council.

zh.s: 皮埃蒙特大区于2019年5月26日举行选举，与2019年意大利欧洲议会选举同日。此次选举改选皮埃蒙特大区议会全部50名议员，同时选举大区主席；主席也是议会成员。

en.s: An election was held in Spain on 26 May 2019 as part of the concurrent EU-wide election to the 9th European Parliament. All 54 seats allocated to the Spanish constituency as per the Treaty of Lisbon—59 after Brexit was formalized on 31 January 2020—were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 西班牙于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，与欧盟其他成员国同期选举第九届欧洲议会。根据《里斯本条约》，西班牙选区原分配54个席位；英国于2020年1月31日正式退出欧盟后，席位数增至59。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举及全国各地的地方选举同时举行。

en.s: An election was held in Austria on 26 May 2019 to elect the country's 18 members of the European Parliament. The Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) gained two seats for a total of seven, while the Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) and The Greens each lost one. The election took place nine days after the start of the Ibiza affair, which led to the resignation of Vice-Chancellor and FPÖ leader Heinz-Christian Strache and the collapse of the federal ÖVP–FPÖ government.

zh.s: 奥地利于2019年5月26日举行选举，选出该国18名欧洲议会议员。奥地利人民党（ÖVP）增加两个席位，共获7席；奥地利自由党（FPÖ）和绿党则各失去1席。投票日距伊维萨事件爆发9天；该事件导致副总理兼自由党领袖海因茨-克里斯蒂安·施特拉赫辞职，并使奥地利人民党—自由党联合政府垮台。

en.s: On Sunday 26 May 2019, a vote was held to elect the Polish delegation to the European Parliament. Polish voters elected 52 MEPs, compared to 51 in the 2014 election. The increased number of MEPs is a result of the 2018 reapportionment of seats in the European Parliament. Following the United Kingdom's announcement, that it will participate in elections to the European Parliament on May 23, Poland will continue to be represented by 51 MEPs.

zh.s: 2019年5月26日（星期日），波兰举行选举，选出波兰代表团的欧洲议会议员。波兰选民选出52名议员，比2014年多1名；这是根据2018年欧洲议会席位重新分配方案增加的席位。英国宣布将参加5月23日的欧洲议会选举后，波兰仍将由51名议员代表。

en.s: The 2019 EFL League One play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2019 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Charlton Athletic and Sunderland to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from EFL League One to the EFL Championship.

zh.s: 2019年英甲升级附加赛决赛于2019年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是查尔顿竞技和桑德兰。这场比赛决定哪支球队成为第三支、也是最后一支从英甲升入英冠的球队。

en.s: The election of the 5th delegation from Bulgaria to the European Parliament was held on 26 May 2019. All seats were up for election. The country forms a single constituency, with members elected by proportional representation using open lists.

zh.s: 保加利亚于2019年5月26日举行选举，选出第五届保加利亚欧洲议会代表团。所有席位均开放竞选。全境为一个选区，议员通过开放名单比例代表制选出。

en.s: An election was held on 26 May 2019 to elect six representatives from Cyprus to the European Parliament. The Democratic Rally (DISY) has won every election to the European Parliament since Cyprus joined the European Union in 2004. According to final results, DISY again won the election with 29% and 2 seats. There were no changes in seat allocation, with AKEL also at 2 seats after securing 27% of the vote.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于2019年5月26日举行选举，选出6名欧洲议会议员。自塞浦路斯于2004年加入欧盟以来，民主大会党（DISY）赢得了该国历次欧洲议会选举。根据最终结果，民主大会党以29%的得票率再次获胜，赢得2席。席位分配没有变化，劳动人民进步党（AKEL）也以27%的得票率获得2席。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Romania on 26 May 2019.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举。

en.s: Elections for the 2019 European Parliament election in Luxembourg were held on 26 May 2019. Ten parties contested the election for Luxembourg's six seats in the European Parliament. The Democratic Party won the highest percentage of the vote with 21.4 %, making it the first time this party came first in an election in Luxembourg.

zh.s: 卢森堡于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，争夺该国在欧洲议会的6个席位，共有10个政党参选。民主党以21.4%的得票率位居第一，这是该党首次在卢森堡选举中获胜。

en.s: The 2019 European Parliament election in Italy were held on 26 May 2019, electing members of the 9th Italian delegation to the European Parliament as part of the European elections held across the European Union.

zh.s: 意大利于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国第九届欧洲议会代表团成员。这是欧盟各国同期举行的欧洲议会选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2019 Hamburg borough elections were elections held in the seven boroughs of Hamburg on 26 May 2019. The Greens became the strongest party in five (later four) out of the seven boroughs.

zh.s: 汉堡七个区于2019年5月26日举行区议会选举。绿党在七个区中的五个（后来为四个）成为第一大党。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in France on 26 May 2019 (and on 25 May in parts of overseas France and for some nationals abroad), electing members of the 9th French delegation to the European Parliament as part of the elections held across the European Union.

zh.s: 法国于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国第九届欧洲议会代表团成员。法国海外领地部分地区以及一些海外选民于5月25日投票。此次选举是欧盟各国同期选举的一部分。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Madrid on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th City Council of the municipality. All 57 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 马德里于2019年5月26日举行市政选举，选出该市第十一届市议会。全部57个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in Asturias on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th General Junta of the autonomous community. All 45 seats in the General Junta were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.t: 2019年阿斯图里亚斯自治区选举
zh.s: 阿斯图里亚斯于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十一届总议会。全部45个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Community of Madrid on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th Assembly of the autonomous community. All 132 seats in the Assembly were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 马德里自治区于2019年5月26日举行选举，选出该自治区第十一届议会。全部132个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Region of Murcia on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Regional Assembly of the autonomous community. All 45 seats in the Regional Assembly were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 穆尔西亚自治区于2019年5月26日举行选举，选出该自治区第十届地区议会。全部45个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Valencia on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th City Council of the municipality. All 33 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 瓦伦西亚于2019年5月26日举行市政选举，选出该市第十一届市议会。全部33个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: An election for the Members of the European Parliament from Estonia took place on May 26, 2019. Due to the United Kingdom's impending withdrawal from the European Union and the redistribution of its European Parliament seats, the number of elected MEPs from Estonia was increased from six to seven.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国的欧洲议会议员。由于英国即将退出欧盟，欧洲议会席位重新分配，爱沙尼亚当选议员人数从6人增至7人。
