en.s: A regional election was held in Extremadura on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Assembly of the autonomous community. All 65 seats in the Assembly were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.t: 2019年埃斯特雷马杜拉自治区选举
zh.s: 埃斯特雷马杜拉于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会。全部65个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Finland to the European Parliament took place on 26 May 2019. A working committee consisting of the party secretaries of all parliamentary parties suggested in May 2017 that the 2019 Finnish parliamentary election, scheduled for April, should be organized simultaneously with the European Parliament election. The suggestion was considered by the Minister of Justice Antti Häkkänen, but did not have enough parliamentary support to pass.

zh.s: 芬兰于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出芬兰代表团成员。2017年5月，一个由各议会政党秘书组成的工作委员会建议将原定于当年4月举行的芬兰议会选举与欧洲议会选举安排在同一天。司法部长安蒂·哈坎宁考虑了这项建议，但它未能获得足够的议会支持，因而没有通过。

en.s: The 2019 Cantabrian regional election was held on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Parliament of the autonomous community of Cantabria. All 35 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 坎塔布里亚于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会。全部35个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: An election was held in Portugal on Sunday, 26 May 2019, to elect the Portuguese delegation to the European Parliament from 2019 to 2024. This was the eighth European Parliament election held in Portugal. The Socialist Party (PS) was the winner of the election, scoring 33.4 percent of the vote. The party increased their share of the votes by 2 percentage points from the 2014 election, and won an additional seat.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于2019年5月26日（星期日）举行选举，选出2019至2024年葡萄牙欧洲议会代表团。这是葡萄牙第八次举行欧洲议会选举。社会党（PS）以33.4%的得票率胜出，比2014年提高2个百分点，并多赢得一个席位。

en.s: A regional election was held in Navarre on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Parliament of the chartered community. All 50 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 纳瓦拉于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治共同体第十届议会。全部50个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: 2019 European Parliament elections were held in Slovenia on 26 May 2019.

zh.t: 2019年斯洛文尼亚欧洲议会选举
zh.s: 斯洛文尼亚于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举。

en.s: The 2019 Ceuta Assembly election, was held on Sunday, 26 May 2019, to elect the 7th Assembly of the Autonomous City of Ceuta. All 25 seats in the Assembly were up for election. The election was held simultaneously with regional elections in thirteen autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 休达于2019年5月26日（星期日）举行议会选举，选出该自治区第七届议会。议会全部25个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙13个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Barcelona on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th City Council of the municipality. All 41 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election in Spain.

zh.s: 巴塞罗那于2019年5月26日举行市政选举，选出该市第十一届市议会。全部41个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及西班牙2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

loc: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰，西班牙

en.s: A regional election was held in Castilla–La Mancha on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Cortes of the autonomous community. All 33 seats in the Cortes were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.t: 2019年卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰自治区选举
zh.s: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会（Cortes）。全部33个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Croatia on 26 May 2019, electing members of the national Croatia constituency to the European Parliament. These were the third such elections in the country since its accession to the European Union in 2013. It was the first election to be held nationally since the 2016 parliamentary election, following which the center-right HDZ had formed a coalition government, first with the center-right MOST and later - in June 2017, with the centrist HNS.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出克罗地亚全国选区的欧洲议会议员。这是克罗地亚于2013年加入欧盟后举行的第三次欧洲议会选举，也是2016年议会选举后首次全国性选举。2016年选举后，中右翼的克罗地亚民主共同体（HDZ）先与中右翼桥党（MOST）组成联合政府，后于2017年6月改与中间派的人民党—改革党（HNS）联合执政。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Greece on 26 May 2019 to elect the 21 Greek members of the European Parliament. The elections were held alongside the first round of the local and regional government elections, resulting in a major defeat for the governing Syriza party, and leading to Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras bringing forward the scheduled parliamentary elections for 7 July 2019.

zh.s: 希腊于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出21名希腊籍欧洲议会议员。选举与地方和大区选举首轮投票同时举行。执政党激进左翼联盟（Syriza）遭遇重大失利，总理亚历克西斯·齐普拉斯因此提前举行原定于2019年7月7日举行的议会选举。

en.s: A regional election was held in Aragon on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Cortes of the autonomous community. All 67 seats in the Cortes were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 阿拉贡于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会（Cortes）。全部67个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: An election was held on 26 May 2019 in the three Belgian constituencies (the Dutch-speaking electoral college, the French-speaking electoral college and the German-speaking electoral college) to elect the Belgian delegation to the European Parliament. It was part of the 2019 European Parliament election. A royal order of 15 June 2018 fixed the date of the European Parliament election in Belgium, following an agreement at European level.

zh.s: 比利时于2019年5月26日在三个选区举行选举，分别是荷兰语选举团、法语选举团和德语选举团，选出比利时欧洲议会代表团。此次选举是2019年欧洲议会选举的一部分。比利时根据2018年6月15日颁布的王室法令确定了投票日期，此前欧盟层面已达成相关协议。

en.s: Local elections were held in Spain on 26 May 2019 to elect all 66,979 councillors in the 8,131 Spanish municipalities (including 50 seats in the assemblies of the autonomous cities of Ceuta and Melilla), all 1,191 provincial seats in 41 provinces (including 38 indirectly-elected provincial deputations and the three foral deputations in the Basque Country) and 233 seats in ten island councils (seven Canarian and four Balearic ones).

zh.s: 西班牙于2019年5月26日举行地方选举，选出全国8131个市镇的全部66979名议员（包括休达和梅利利亚两个自治市议会的50个席位）、41个省的1191个席位（其中包括38个间接选举产生的省级议会席位，以及巴斯克地区的3个地方自治议会席位），以及10个岛屿议会的233个席位（加那利群岛7个，巴利阿里群岛4个）。

en.s: An election of Members of the European Parliament from Hungary to the European Parliament was held on 26 May 2019, electing the 21 members of the Hungary delegation to the European Parliament as part of the European elections held across the European Union.

zh.s: 匈牙利于2019年5月26日举行欧洲议会选举，选出21名匈牙利籍欧洲议会议员。这是欧盟各国同期举行的欧洲议会选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2019 Saarland local elections were held on May 26, 2019 to elect members of Saarland's 6 district councils and 52 municipal councils. Voters also elected the state's 34 directly-elected mayors. The elections were held on the same day as the 2019 European Parliament election in Germany.

zh.s: 萨尔州于2019年5月26日举行地方选举，选出该州6个县议会和52个市镇议会的成员。选民还直接选举了该州34名市长。选举与2019年德国欧洲议会选举同日举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in Castile and León on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Cortes of the autonomous community. All 81 seats in the Cortes were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.t: 2019年卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区选举
zh.s: 卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会（Cortes）。全部81个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2019 European Parliament election was held in the European Union (EU) between 23 and 26 May 2019. It was the ninth parliamentary election since the first direct elections in 1979. A total of 751 Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) were elected to represent more than 512 million people from 28 member states.

zh.s: 欧盟于2019年5月23日至26日举行欧洲议会选举。这是自1979年首次直接选举以来的第九次议会选举。来自28个成员国、代表超过5.12亿人的751名欧洲议会议员在此次选举中当选。

en.s: The 2019 Bremen state election was held on 26 May 2019 to elect the members of the Bürgerschaft of Bremen, as well as the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The election took place on the same day as the 2019 European Parliament election. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) became the largest party in the Bürgerschaft, while the Social Democratic Party (SPD) fell to second place.

zh.s: 不来梅于2019年5月26日举行州选举，选举不来梅州议会成员，同时选举不来梅市和不来梅哈芬市议会。选举与2019年欧洲议会选举同日举行。反对党基督教民主联盟（CDU）成为州议会第一大党，社会民主党（SPD）跌至第二位。

en.s: The 2019 Riojan regional election was held on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Parliament of the autonomous community of La Rioja. All 33 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 拉里奥哈于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会。全部33个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Balearic Islands on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 59 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.t: 2019年巴利阿里群岛自治区选举
zh.s: 巴利阿里群岛于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会。全部59个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2019 Cretan regional election took place on 26 May 2019, simultaneously with the rest of Greece. The election was for all 51 elected seats of the Regional Council of Crete as well as the Regional Governor. This was the third Cretan regional election and the incumbent Governor (Stavros Arnaoutakis, PASOK) ran for a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 克里特大区于2019年5月26日与希腊其他地区同时举行选举，改选大区议会全部51个民选席位，并选出大区主席。这是克里特岛第三次举行大区选举。时任大区主席、泛希腊社会主义运动（PASOK）成员斯塔夫罗斯·阿尔瑙塔基斯寻求连续第三次连任。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Zaragoza on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th City Council of the municipality. All 31 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 萨拉戈萨于2019年5月26日举行市政选举，选出该市第十一届市议会。全部31个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Seville on 26 May 2019 to elect the 11th City Council of the municipality. All 31 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 塞维利亚于2019年5月26日举行市政选举，选出该市第十一届市议会。全部31个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2019 Aranese Council Election, was held on Sunday, 26 May 2019, to elect the General Council of Aran, an administrative entity in the province of Lleida (Spain). All 13 seats in the Council were up for election. The election was held simultaneously with regional elections in twelve autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 阿兰于2019年5月26日（星期日）举行选举，选出阿兰总委员会。阿兰是西班牙莱里达省的一个行政实体。议会全部13个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙12个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2019 Melilla Assembly election was held on Sunday, 26 May 2019, to elect the 7th Assembly of the Autonomous City of Melilla. All 25 seats in the Assembly were up for election. The election was held simultaneously with regional elections in thirteen autonomous communities and local elections all throughout Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.t: 2019年梅利利亚自治区议会选举
zh.s: 梅利利亚于2019年5月26日（星期日）举行议会选举，选出该自治区第七届议会。议会全部25个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙13个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Canary Islands on 26 May 2019 to elect the 10th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 70 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with regional elections in eleven other autonomous communities and local elections all across Spain, as well as the 2019 European Parliament election.

zh.s: 加那利群岛于2019年5月26日举行自治区选举，选出该自治区第十届议会。全部70个席位均开放竞选。此次选举与西班牙另外11个自治区的选举、全国各地的地方选举以及2019年欧洲议会选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2019 Belgian regional elections took place on Sunday 26 May, the same day as the 2019 European Parliament election as well as the Belgian federal election. In the regional elections, new representatives were chosen for the Flemish Parliament, Walloon Parliament, Brussels Parliament and the Parliament of the German-speaking Community. The Parliament of the French Community was composed of all elected members of the Walloon Parliament (except German-speaking members) and 19 of the French-speaking members of the Brussels Parliament.

zh.s: 比利时于2019年5月26日（星期日）举行大区选举，与2019年欧洲议会选举和比利时联邦选举同日。选举产生佛兰德议会、瓦隆议会、布鲁塞尔议会和德语社群议会的新代表。法语社群议会则由瓦隆议会所有当选议员（不包括德语议员）以及布鲁塞尔议会的19名法语议员组成。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Sweden in May 2019 to elect the country's twenty members of the European Parliament.

zh.s: 瑞典于2019年5月举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国的20名欧洲议会议员。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 12 May 2019, with a second round held on 26 May 2019. Due to a constitutional limit of two terms in office, incumbent president Dalia Grybauskaitė was unable to run, having won the 2009 and 2014 elections. As no candidate obtained 50% of the vote in the first round, a second round was held between the top two candidates, Ingrida Šimonytė and Gitanas Nausėda.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2019年5月12日举行总统选举，5月26日进行第二轮投票。根据宪法，总统最多只能连任两届，时任总统达莉娅·格里包斯凯特已于2009年和2014年当选，不能参选。首轮投票无人获得50%的选票，因此得票前两名的因格丽达·希莫尼特和吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达参加第二轮投票。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Spain during 2019 to elect the regional parliaments of thirteen of the seventeen autonomous communities: Aragon, Asturias, the Balearic Islands, the Canary Islands, Cantabria, Castile and León, Castilla–La Mancha, Extremadura, La Rioja, Madrid, Murcia, Navarre and the Valencian Community. 814 of 1,208 seats in the regional parliaments were up for election.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙于2019年举行自治区选举，改选17个自治区中的13个自治区议会：阿拉贡、阿斯图里亚斯、巴利阿里群岛、加那利群岛、坎塔布里亚、卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂、卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰、埃斯特雷马杜拉、拉里奥哈、马德里、穆尔西亚、纳瓦拉和瓦伦西亚自治区。自治区议会1,208个席位中有814席开放竞选。选举于5月26日举行。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的赛事日期。

en.s: On May 26, 2021, a mass shooting occurred at a Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) rail yard in San Jose, California, United States. A 57-year-old VTA employee, Samuel James Cassidy, shot and killed nine VTA employees before killing himself. It is the deadliest mass shooting in the history of the San Francisco Bay Area. As a result of the shooting, service throughout the VTA light rail system was suspended or limited for months.

zh.s: 2021年5月26日，美国加利福尼亚州圣何塞市谷交通局（VTA）铁路维修场发生大规模枪击案。57岁的VTA员工塞缪尔·詹姆斯·卡西迪枪杀了9名VTA员工，随后自杀。这是旧金山湾区历史上伤亡最惨重的大规模枪击案。枪击案发生后，VTA轻轨系统的服务停运或受限，持续了数月。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Syria on 26 May 2021, with expatriates able to vote in some embassies abroad on 20 May. This was the last presidential election to be held in Ba'athist Syria, prior to its overthrow following the 2024 Syrian opposition offensive. The three candidates were incumbent president Bashar al-Assad, Mahmoud Ahmad Marei and Abdullah Sallum Abdullah. The elections were considered not to be free and fair.

zh.s: 叙利亚于2021年5月26日举行总统选举，部分海外侨民可于5月20日在一些使馆投票。这是复兴党统治下的叙利亚举行的最后一次总统选举；2024年叙利亚反对派攻势后，复兴党政权被推翻。三名候选人是时任总统巴沙尔·阿萨德、马哈茂德·艾哈迈德·马雷和阿卜杜拉·萨卢姆·阿卜杜拉。外界普遍认为这次选举既不自由，也不公正。

en.s: The 2021 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2020–21 UEFA Europa League, the 50th season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 12th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. It was played on 26 May 2021 at the Stadion Gdańsk in Gdańsk, Poland, between Spanish club Villarreal and English club Manchester United.

zh.s: 2021年欧洲联赛决赛是2020—21赛季欧洲联赛的决赛，也是欧足联欧洲第二级俱乐部足球赛事的第50个赛季决赛。从欧洲联盟杯更名为欧洲联赛以来，这是第12届赛事。比赛于2021年5月26日在波兰格但斯克的格但斯克体育场举行，参赛双方是西班牙比利亚雷亚尔和英格兰曼彻斯特联。

en.s: The Chindwin River ambushes are a series of ambushes conducted by the People's Defense Force (PDF) and local anti-junta militias against Myanmar Army supply boats traveling across the Chindwin. Initially, anti-junta forces relied on single-shot Tumi guns to ambush the boats. As the Myanmar civil war raged on, the PDF and allied local militias would eventually use automatic weapons and explosives to attack the boats.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 钦敦江伏击战是人民防卫军（PDF）和当地反军政府民兵对缅甸军队补给船发动的一系列伏击。起初，反军政府武装依靠单发图米枪袭击船只。随着缅甸内战持续，他们后来开始使用自动武器和爆炸物袭击补给船。
zh.n: 此条记录的是资料信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 2022 Croatian Cup final between the Adriatic rivals Rijeka and Hajduk Split was played on 26 May 2022 in Split, Croatia.

zh.s: 亚得里亚海沿岸两支宿敌球队里耶卡和斯普利特海杜克之间的2022年克罗地亚杯决赛，于2022年5月26日在克罗地亚斯普利特举行。

en.s: The 2022 Turkish Cup final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2021–22 Turkish Cup, the 60th edition of Turkey's primary football cup. The match was played on 26 May 2022 at the Atatürk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul between Kayserispor and Sivasspor. Sivasspor won 3–2 after extra time for their first Turkish Cup title.

zh.s: 2022年土耳其杯决赛决出了2021—22赛季土耳其顶级足球杯赛冠军，是该项赛事第60届决赛。比赛于2022年5月26日在伊斯坦布尔阿塔图尔克奥林匹克体育场举行，参赛双方是开塞利体育和锡瓦斯体育。锡瓦斯体育在加时赛后以3比2获胜，首次夺得土耳其杯。

en.s: The 2022 Danish Cup final was played on 26 May 2022 between OB and Midjylland at Brøndby Stadium, Brøndbyvester, a neutral ground. The final match was the culmination of the 2021–22 Danish Cup, the 68th season of the Sydbank Pokalen. OB appeared in their 7th Cup final, sporting a 5–1 record in cup finals. The club's last Cup title came in 2007.

zh.s: 2022年丹麦杯决赛于2022年5月26日举行，参赛双方是欧登塞和中日德兰，比赛地点是位于布隆德比韦斯特的布隆德比体育场，这是一座中立场地。这是2021—22赛季丹麦杯决赛，也是Sydbank Pokalen第68个赛季的收官战。欧登塞第七次打进杯赛决赛，此前战绩为5胜1负；球队上一次夺冠是在2007年。

en.s: The battle of Buulo Mareer took place on 26 May 2023, when Al-Shabaab fighters stormed an African Union military camp manned by Ugandan forces in the town of Bulo Marer, Lower Shabelle, Somalia. The attack remains the deadliest on ATMIS troops (successor to AMISOM) since their formation in April 2022 and is also Uganda's worst defeat in Somalia since its deployment in February 2007.

zh.s: 2023年5月26日，青年党武装人员突袭了索马里下谢贝利州布洛马雷尔镇的一处非洲联盟军事营地；营地由乌干达部队驻守。这次袭击仍是非洲联盟驻索马里过渡特派团（ATMIS，前身为非洲联盟驻索马里特派团AMISOM）自2022年4月成立以来伤亡最惨重的一次，也是乌干达部队自2007年2月部署到索马里以来最惨重的一次失败。

en.s: The 2024 EFL Championship play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2024 at Wembley Stadium in London, England, between Leeds United and Southampton. The match was to determine the third and final team to gain promotion from the EFL Championship, the second tier of English football, to the Premier League. Leeds United and Southampton had finished third and fourth respectively in the league season.

zh.s: 2024年英冠升级附加赛决赛于2024年5月26日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，参赛双方是利兹联和南安普敦。比赛决定哪支球队成为第三支、也是最后一支从英格兰第二级联赛英冠升入英超的球队。联赛常规赛中，利兹联和南安普敦分别排名第三和第四。

en.s: The 2024 Shizuoka Prefecture Gubernatorial Election was an election to elect the governor of Shizuoka Prefecture in Japan, held on May 26, 2024.

zh.s: 日本于2024年5月26日举行静冈县知事选举。

en.s: On 26 May 2024, Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) jihadists attacked a Malian Army and Wagner Group base in Mourdiah, Koulikoro Region, Mali. The attack was repelled, and dozens of jihadists were killed.

zh.s: 2024年5月26日，“支持伊斯兰和穆斯林组织”（JNIM）的圣战分子袭击了马里库利科罗大区穆尔迪亚的一处马里军队和瓦格纳集团基地。袭击被击退，数十名圣战分子被击毙。

en.s: Snap regional elections were held in Madeira on 26 May 2024, to determine the composition of the Legislative Assembly of the Autonomous Region of Madeira. The election replaced all 47 members of the Madeira Assembly, and the new members will then elect the President of the Autonomous Region.

zh.s: 马德拉于2024年5月26日提前举行自治区选举，决定马德拉自治区立法议会的组成。议会全部47名议员重新选举产生，新议员随后将选出自治区主席。

en.s: The 2024 Taça de Portugal final was the last match of the 2023–24 Taça de Portugal, which decided the winner of the 84th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier knockout cup competition in Portuguese football. It was played on 26 May 2024 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, between Primeira Liga sides Sporting CP and Porto.

zh.s: 2024年葡萄牙杯决赛是2023—24赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，决出了葡萄牙顶级足球淘汰赛赛事第84个赛季的冠军。比赛于2024年5月26日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，参赛双方是葡超球队里斯本竞技和波尔图。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 12 May 2024, alongside a referendum on allowing multiple citizenships. Incumbent President Gitanas Nausėda won re-election to a second term. When candidate registrations closed before the election, the Lithuanian Central Election Commission had confirmed fifteen viable registrations; of those, twelve proceeded to collect signatures from the minimum 20,000 voters. Four of those contenders were later repudiated or dropped out, leaving eight on the ballot.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2024年5月12日举行总统选举，同时就允许多重国籍举行公投。现任总统吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达成功连任，开始第二个任期。候选人登记结束时，立陶宛中央选举委员会确认有15人符合参选资格；其中12人开始征集至少2万名选民的签名。后来有4人被取消资格或退出，最终有8人列入选票。
zh.n: 此条记录的是第二轮投票日期。

en.s: On 26 May 2025, Paul Doyle drove a grey Ford Galaxy into a crowd on Water Street in Liverpool, England, during a victory parade celebrating Liverpool Football Club's 2024–25 Premier League title win. Over 130 people were injured; at least 50 were taken to hospital, including four children.

zh.t: 2025年利物浦夺冠游行冲撞事件
zh.s: 2025年5月26日，保罗·道尔驾驶一辆灰色福特Galaxy汽车冲入英格兰利物浦水街上的人群。当时人们正在举行夺冠游行，庆祝利物浦足球俱乐部赢得2024—25赛季英超冠军。超过130人受伤，其中至少50人被送往医院，包括4名儿童。

en.s: The 2025 EFL League Two play-off final was an association football match which was played on 26 May 2025 at Wembley Stadium, London, to determine the fourth and final team to gain promotion from EFL League Two, the fourth tier of English football, to EFL League One.

zh.s: 2025年英乙升级附加赛决赛于2025年5月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决定哪支球队成为第四支、也是最后一支从英格兰第四级联赛英乙升入英甲的球队。

en.s: The 2025 Khan Yunis offensive was a major military engagement that began on 26 May 2025 as part of the broader Israeli offensive in the Gaza Strip launched in May 2025, known as Operation Gideon's Chariots, during the ongoing Gaza war. It marked the fourth time that Israel invaded Khan Yunis since the beginning of the war.

zh.s: 2025年汗尤尼斯攻势于2025年5月26日开始，是以色列2025年5月在加沙地带发动的更大规模攻势“基甸战车行动”的一部分，也是加沙战争持续期间的一场重要军事行动。这是战争爆发以来以色列第四次入侵汗尤尼斯。
